company.zh: ViCREA
company.en: ViCREA

launch.en: April 5, 2018

market.zh: 日本全国药妆、综合零售、品牌电商及跨境电商
market.en: Japanese drugstores, general retail, brand e-commerce and cross-border e-commerce

positioning.zh: 以“头发水分量 14%”和“保水有机美容”为核心，把蜂蜜、有机油和美容液成分组合成高保湿洗护体系。产品的核心差异是把整个洗护流程都指向“保持发丝水分”这一件事。系列化步骤编号、香味变化和高装饰性瓶身进一步强化仪式感。
positioning.en: Built around “14% hair moisture” and a moisture-organic beauty proposition. Honey, organic oils and beauty-serum ingredients are organized into a hydration system. The core difference is that the entire wash routine points to one goal — keeping hair hydrated. Numbered steps, changing fragrances and jewel-like packaging create ritual value.

target.zh: 面向干燥、毛躁、缺水、卷曲和希望获得明显滋润感的人群。品牌视觉年轻、甜美、适合社交媒体传播，核心用户更偏年轻女性，但实际购买人群很广。对细软、容易塌发的人群，Deep Moist 的丰润感可能偏重。
target.en: For consumers with dry, frizzy and moisture-depleted hair who want a rich conditioning feel. The brand’s visual language is young, sweet and social-media friendly, although its actual audience is broad.

distribution.zh: 440 mL / ¥1,540，与日本大众高机能洗护主流价位一致。全国药妆、Ainz & Tulpe、综合零售、电商覆盖广，渠道优势明显。长期在售与高评论量形成较强社会证明，替代成本来自品牌认知而非高技术壁垒。
distribution.en: 440 mL at ¥1,540, aligned with Japan’s mainstream mass-premium haircare segment. Wide drugstore, lifestyle retail and e-commerce distribution gives the brand a major channel advantage.

ingredients.zh: 品牌强调 90% 以上由蜂蜜、有机油、蜂王浆等保湿与保护成分构成，并使用摩洛哥有机油。蜂蜜配比故事为 Manuka 50%、Acacia 30%、日本生蜂蜜 20%。洗净体系配合油脂、保湿剂和调理成分，目标是减少洗后干涩并维持含水感。
ingredients.en: The brand emphasizes that more than 90% of the formula consists of honey, organic oils, royal jelly and other moisturizing or protective ingredients. The honey story uses a 50% Manuka, 30% Acacia and 20% Japanese raw honey blend.

evidence.zh: 公开资料主要是配方比例、成分来源、自由配方和消费者评论。没有在官方产品页看到完整临床或仪器测试方案。其证据优势来自长期市场销售、较高评论量和清晰的成分比例传播，而非公开临床研究。
evidence.en: Public evidence is mainly formula ratios, ingredient sourcing, free-from claims and large volumes of consumer reviews. No full clinical or instrumental study protocol was found on the official product page.

experience.zh: 浓厚的 Shea & Honey 泡沫，Peony Honey 香味，洗后追求柔软、滋润、香气持续和毛躁改善。瓶身厚重、透明、带切割感和蜂蜜色液体，视觉非常适合货架和社交媒体。使用体验偏丰润，对重度干燥发更有吸引力。
experience.en: Rich Shea & Honey foam, Peony Honey fragrance and a strongly moisturized finish. The faceted transparent bottle, amber liquid and gold pump create high shelf visibility and social-media appeal.

packaging.zh: 琥珀色透明液体、几何切面瓶和金色泵头构成极强的蜂蜜高级感。步骤编号 1.0、1.5、2.0 让消费者自然理解整套使用顺序。包装是其最难被低成本复制的品牌资产之一。
packaging.en: Amber liquid, a geometric faceted bottle, gold hardware and numbered steps create a strong premium honey identity. Packaging is one of the brand’s hardest assets to copy cheaply.

insight.zh: &honey 的成功说明大众洗护的竞争不一定依赖新型活性，而可以通过一个极强的单一概念——“保水”——把配方、包装、香味、步骤和渠道统一起来。研发层面容易模仿，品牌层面难以复制。
insight.en: &honey shows that mass haircare can win without a new active by aligning formula, packaging, fragrance, usage steps and distribution around one powerful memory structure: moisture.

company.zh: Stella Seed
company.en: Stella Seed

launch.zh: 系列既有产品；现版本于 2025 年夏季更新
launch.en: Existing range; current version renewed in summer 2025

market.zh: 日本全国药妆、电商、Loft / PLAZA 等
market.en: Japanese drugstores, e-commerce, Loft, PLAZA and lifestyle retail

capacity.zh: 本体 475 mL / 替换装 400 mL

positioning.zh: “护肤化的保水美容液洗发水”。把海洋来源成分、干细胞提取物概念、PPT 系洗净成分和 84% 美容液成分整合为高保湿修护的宣称方向。差异点是“洗发步骤即美容液护理”这一整体概念，成分本身并不独特。
positioning.en: A skincare-inspired moisture serum shampoo that combines marine-derived ingredients, stem-cell-extract concepts, PPT cleansing agents and an “84% beauty serum ingredients” claim. Its differentiation is the overall idea that shampooing itself functions as a serum-care step; the individual actives are not unique.

target.zh: 核心面向干燥、毛躁、打结、缺乏光泽、有染烫或热工具损伤的人群。年龄并未在官方页面明确限定，视觉风格更接近重视成分感、简洁包装和药妆可得性的年轻至中青年消费者。
target.en: Aimed at people with dryness, frizz, tangling, dullness and damage from coloring, perming or heat tools. The minimalist packaging and ingredient-focused language appeal mainly to young and middle-aged beauty consumers.

distribution.zh: 本体 475 mL / ¥1,540；替换装 400 mL / ¥1,210。属于日本中价位大众高机能洗护，依赖药妆与大型生活方式零售触达，同时通过官方电商和平台电商覆盖。
distribution.en: 475 mL at ¥1,540 and a 400 mL refill at ¥1,210. It sits in Japan’s mid-priced mass-premium haircare segment, with broad distribution through drugstores, lifestyle retailers and e-commerce.

ingredients.zh: 氨基酸系洗净成分 + PPT 系洗净成分；代表成分包括 Cocoyl Hydrolyzed Collagen K、Cocoyl Hydrolyzed Keratin K。Polyquaternium-51 作为保湿与顺滑强化点，“Thalasso stem-cell formula”则是品牌复合概念。新版去除了 Olefin(C12-16) Sulfonate Na，意图降低强清洁印象。
ingredients.en: Amino-acid cleansing agents plus PPT-derived surfactants, including Cocoyl Hydrolyzed Collagen K and Cocoyl Hydrolyzed Keratin K. Polyquaternium-51 strengthens hydration and slip, while the “Thalasso stem-cell formula” acts as the brand’s composite technology claim.

evidence.zh: 当前公开页面以配方、成分功能及品牌内部比较为主。公开资料明确提到产品中 84% 为美容液成分，但该比例包含水；未看到完整第三方临床报告、详细样本量或公开统计结果。
evidence.en: Public materials focus on formula composition, ingredient functions and internal brand comparisons. The 84% beauty-serum figure includes water. No complete third-party clinical report or detailed sample size was found.

experience.zh: 透明或半透明大容量泵瓶，银白色泵头与竖排极简标签强化“水感、洁净、实验室感”。香型为 Aqua White Floral。洗发剂型强调浓密泡沫、温和清洁、洗后湿润与“ぷるん髪”弹润感。
experience.en: A transparent large pump bottle with silver-white hardware and vertical minimalist labeling. Aqua White Floral fragrance. The product emphasizes rich foam, mild cleansing, moisturized feel and bouncy, supple hair.

packaging.zh: 极简透明瓶、垂直排版和银白配色是品牌货架辨识度最高的元素。视觉同时传达海洋、水感和实验室美容液。优点是货架辨识度高；风险是系列扩张后不同功效款外观相近。
packaging.en: The transparent bottle, vertical typography and silver-white palette strongly convey water, marine beauty and laboratory skincare. Shelf recognition is high, although multiple variants can be difficult to distinguish.

insight.zh: 真正值得研究的是整合能力：把 PPT 洗净成分、阳离子保湿聚合物、海洋成分与干细胞概念组合成一个消费者能理解的 Skinification 故事。“84% 美容液”只是这套组合的对外数字表达。
insight.en: The most valuable lesson is the integration itself: PPT cleansing agents, a moisturizing polymer, marine ingredients and stem-cell language combined into one understandable skinification concept. The 84% figure is simply how that combination is expressed to consumers.

name.zh: Advanced Clinicals Keratin Sleek + Smooth Hair Mask
name.en: Advanced Clinicals Keratin Sleek + Smooth Hair Mask

company.zh: Advanced Clinicals（cosmeceuticals平价功效护肤品牌）
company.en: Advanced Clinicals (an accessible-priced cosmeceuticals brand)

launch.zh: 品牌核心护发系列常规单品
launch.en: A standard item in the brand's core haircare lineup

market.zh: Walmart、iHerb、Amazon等美国大众/电商渠道
market.en: Walmart, iHerb, Amazon and other US mass/e-commerce channels

positioning.zh: 以角蛋白+乳木果油为核心的强效补水发膜，主打软化强韧受损发丝、改善顺滑与光泽，走科学驱动的平价功效品牌定位。
positioning.en: A keratin + shea butter intensive hydrating hair mask, positioned to soften and strengthen weak hair while improving smoothness and shine, under the brand's science-driven, accessible positioning.

target.zh: 干燥、毛躁、易断裂或经过染烫处理的受损发质人群，偏好平价功效型护理而非专业沙龙价位的消费者。
target.en: Dry, frizzy, breakage-prone or color-treated damaged hair; consumers who prefer accessible, science-positioned care over professional salon pricing.

ingredients.zh: 水、鲸蜡醇、甘油、双十八烷基二甲基氯化铵、肉豆蔻酸异丙酯、椰子油、水解角蛋白、丝氨基酸、水解米蛋白、泛醇（维生素B5）、乳木果油、聚季铵盐硅油-3、羟乙基纤维素等。
ingredients.en: Water, cetyl alcohol, glycerin, behentrimonium chloride, isopropyl myristate, coconut oil, hydrolyzed keratin, silk amino acids, hydrolyzed rice protein, panthenol (vitamin B5), shea butter, silicone quaternium-3, hydroxyethylcellulose, and more.

evidence.zh: 宣称主要基于品牌自述的科学驱动配方与成分功效描述，未见公开的独立第三方临床或仪器测试数据；用户评论中有反馈香精浓郁引发头痛等敏感问题。
evidence.en: Claims rest mainly on the brand's self-described science-driven formula and ingredient-function descriptions; no public independent third-party clinical or instrumental data found. Some user reviews note the fragrance is strong enough to cause headaches for sensitive users.

experience.zh: 乳霜质地，清洁湿发后大量涂抹，停留5-10分钟后彻底冲洗；建议头皮易出油人群避开发根使用；每周或按需使用。
experience.en: Creamy texture; apply generously to clean, damp hair, leave on 5-10 minutes, then rinse thoroughly. Those with an oily scalp are advised to avoid the roots; recommended weekly or as needed.

packaging.zh: 塑料瓶身，简洁临床感标签设计（角蛋白、维生素B5等成分icon化呈现），强化科学护理平价定位。
packaging.en: A plastic bottle with a clean, clinical-style label (keratin, vitamin B5 and other ingredients shown as icons), reinforcing the brand's science-driven mass positioning.

insight.zh: Advanced Clinicals证明皮肤科学话语体系可以从护肤品类平移到护发品类，用cosmeceuticals定位在平价市场中建立差异化，但香精浓度等细节仍是用户体验的潜在风险点。
insight.en: Advanced Clinicals shows that a dermatological science vocabulary can transfer from skincare into haircare, using a cosmeceuticals position to differentiate within the mass market, though details like fragrance intensity remain a potential experience risk.

market.zh: 品牌官网、Ulta Beauty、SalonCentric等美妆及沙龙专业渠道
market.en: Brand website, Ulta Beauty, SalonCentric and other beauty/salon professional channels

capacity.zh: 275 mL（另有60 mL小样装、1L大瓶装）

positioning.zh: 以键合强化科技（Bond Fortifying Technology）为核心的修护型洗发水，主打用1次即2倍强韧、减少55%断裂，走沙龙专业与美妆零售兼具的Masstige路线。
positioning.en: A repair shampoo built on Bond Fortifying Technology, positioned around 2x stronger hair with 55% less breakage after one use, a masstige play spanning both salon-professional and beauty-retail channels.

target.zh: 1-4c各类发质中因环境压力、热工具、化学处理导致受损脆弱的人群，尤其是高多孔发质；愿意为临床验证背书支付溢价的消费者。
target.en: All hair types 1-4c experiencing damage from environmental stress, heat tools or chemical treatments, especially high-porosity hair; consumers willing to pay a premium for clinically proven claims.

ingredients.zh: 水、C14-16烯烃磺酸钠、椰油酰胺丙基甜菜碱、甘油、椰油酰两性基二乙酸二钠、PEG-7椰油酸甘油酯、沙棘果/籽油、琉璃苣籽油、牛油果油、芒果籽脂、乳木果油、水解藜麦蛋白（植物蛋白）、薰衣草花提取物、洋甘菊花提取物、迷迭香叶提取物等。
ingredients.en: Water, sodium C14-16 olefin sulfonate, cocamidopropyl betaine, glycerin, disodium cocoamphodiacetate, PEG-7 glyceryl cocoate, sea buckthorn fruit/seed oil, borage seed oil, avocado oil, mango seed butter, shea butter, hydrolyzed quinoa (vegan protein), lavender flower extract, chamomile flower extract, rosemary leaf extract, and more.

evidence.zh: 宣称洗发水+护发素组合使用后1次即2倍强韧、减少55%断裂已经过临床验证；另有安全用于染发的临床验证宣称。完整测试方法、样本量与统计结果未公开披露。
evidence.en: Claims that the shampoo + conditioner system delivers 2x stronger hair with 55% less breakage after one use are described as clinically proven, as is a claim of being clinically proven safe for color-treated hair. Full protocol, sample size and statistics are not publicly disclosed.

experience.zh: 质地丰盈起泡，官方建议双重清洁（洗两次，第一次清洁、第二次吸收精华）；适合高多孔发质，搭配同系列护发素效果最佳；标志性amika水果调香氛。
experience.en: Rich, lathering texture; the brand recommends double cleansing (wash twice, first to clean, second to absorb the benefits). Best suited to high-porosity hair and paired with the matching conditioner; features amika's signature fruity fragrance.

packaging.zh: 采用含消费后回收塑料（PCR）的瓶身，绿色/薄荷色视觉搭配品牌标志性图案，强调可持续性（B Corp认证、气候中和认证）。
packaging.en: Bottle contains post-consumer recycled plastic (PCR), in a mint-green palette with the brand's signature pattern, emphasizing sustainability (B Corp and Climate Neutral certified).

insight.zh: amika的案例说明：临床验证的量化宣称+可持续性认证+沙龙专业渠道三者叠加，可以让一个原本大众价位的洗护品类站上Masstige定价，且不完全依赖单一网红成分。
insight.en: amika shows that stacking clinically proven quantified claims, sustainability certifications and salon-professional channel presence can lift an otherwise mass-priced wash category into masstige pricing, without relying on a single viral hero ingredient.

name.zh: Camille Rose Cocoa Nibs + Honey Ultimate Strength Serum
name.en: Camille Rose Cocoa Nibs + Honey Ultimate Strength Serum

company.zh: Camille Rose Naturals
company.en: Camille Rose Naturals

launch.zh: 品牌长期在售经典单品
launch.en: Long-standing staple in the brand's core lineup

market.zh: Target、Walmart、Ulta、CVS等美国大众零售渠道
market.en: US mass retail: Target, Walmart, Ulta, CVS and more

positioning.zh: 以阿育吠陀余甘子（Amla）油与婆罗米（Brahmi）草本为核心的修护型发油，主打改善头发稀疏与断裂、打开受阻毛囊、促进头皮循环。
positioning.en: An Ayurvedic-inspired restorative hair oil built on amla oil and Brahmi herbal infusions, positioned to combat thinning and breakage while opening blocked follicles and improving scalp circulation.

target.zh: 面临头发稀疏、断裂困扰的天然发/纹理发消费者，偏好美食感命名与草本疗法定位的大众价位购物者。
target.en: Natural/textured-hair consumers dealing with thinning and breakage, drawn to gourmet-style naming and herbal-remedy positioning at a mass price point.

ingredients.zh: 余甘子果提取物、芝麻籽油、椰子油、荷荷巴籽油、橄榄油、夏威夷果籽油、乳木果油、可可籽脂、蜂蜜、生物素、MSM、田菁（Shikakai）提取物、鱼藤木果粉（Aritha）、婆罗米提取物、旱莲草提取物、茶树叶油、BTMS、无邻苯二甲酸盐香精。
ingredients.en: Amla fruit extract, sesame seed oil, coconut oil, jojoba seed oil, olive oil, macadamia seed oil, shea butter, cocoa seed butter, honey, biotin, MSM, shikakai extract, aritha fruit powder, Brahmi extract, bhringraj extract, tea tree leaf oil, BTMS, phthalate-free fragrance.

evidence.zh: 宣称主要基于阿育吠陀传统草本功效描述（余甘子、婆罗米），未见公开的第三方临床或仪器测试数据；电商评论中存在过蜡感/太重的负面反馈，提示配方感官体验因发质而异。
evidence.en: Claims lean mainly on traditional Ayurvedic herbal function (amla, Brahmi); no public third-party clinical or instrumental data found. E-commerce reviews include negative feedback about a waxy/heavy feel, suggesting sensory experience varies by hair type.

experience.zh: 摇匀后取适量按摩头皮，建议隔天睡前使用或按需使用；官方描述为可可与杏仁的美食感香调；部分用户反馈质地偏厚重，需搭配深层清洁使用。
experience.en: Shake well, massage a small amount into the scalp; recommended every other night or as needed. Officially described with a gourmet chocolate-almond scent; some users find the texture heavy and pair it with clarifying washes.

packaging.zh: 塑料按压瓶，卡通感美食标签设计（可可豆插画），走亲和、平价大众零售货架路线，与专业沙龙线的极简克制视觉形成对比。
packaging.en: Plastic squeeze bottle with playful gourmet labeling (cocoa bean illustration), leaning approachable and mass-retail-friendly, a contrast to the minimalist restraint of professional salon lines.

insight.zh: Camille Rose证明草本疗法+美食感命名在美国大众纹理发市场依然是可靠的差异化路径，但产品评论两极分化（圣品vs太腊）提示配方一致性和肤感是其主要风险点。
insight.en: Camille Rose shows that herbal remedy plus gourmet naming remains a reliable differentiation path in the US mass textured-hair market, but polarized reviews (holy grail vs. too waxy) point to formula consistency and sensory feel as its main risk.

positioning.zh: 每日使用的头皮密度精华，主打「密度肽」技术改善发际线与头发密度，是Beyoncé「hair is sacred」品牌仪式感定位的核心单品之一。
positioning.en: A daily scalp density serum built on peptide technology to improve edges and hair density, a hero item in Beyoncé's ritual-driven 'hair is sacred' brand positioning.

target.zh: 发际线稀疏、头发变细、追求「可见密度提升」的消费者；愿意为明星背书的高端仪式化护理买单的人群。
target.en: Consumers with thinning edges or reduced density seeking visible improvement; willing to pay a premium for a celebrity-backed ritual routine.

ingredients.zh: 核心为Biopeptide-5（Acetyl Tetrapeptide-3 + Biotinoyl Tripeptide-1），搭配专利Bioactive Keratin Ferment（乳酸菌/蜂蜜/角蛋白发酵物）、生物素、姜根提取物、玫瑰提取物、薄荷叶提取物。无硅油、SLS/SLES、邻苯二甲酸盐、Paraben。
ingredients.en: Built on Biopeptide-5 (Acetyl Tetrapeptide-3 + Biotinoyl Tripeptide-1) plus a patent-pending Bioactive Keratin Ferment (lactobacillus/honey/keratin ferment), biotin, ginger root extract, rose extract and peppermint leaf extract. Free of silicones, SLS/SLES, phthalates and parabens.

evidence.zh: 第三方消费者研究（16周）显示头发密度可见提升1.5倍；另有84%改善头皮与头发健康的宣称；皮肤科测试、沙龙测试。未见公开的仪器测量或对照组设计细节。
evidence.en: A third-party 16-week consumer study reports up to 1.5x visibly denser hair; also claims 84% improved scalp and hair health. Dermatologist- and salon-tested. Full protocol and control-group details are not publicly disclosed.

experience.zh: 轻盈滴管精华，不油腻，可用于有护发假发或化学处理的头发。每日直接滴于头皮并按摩吸收，不需冲洗。
experience.en: Lightweight, fast-absorbing dropper serum, non-greasy; safe for extensions or chemically treated hair. Applied daily to the scalp and massaged in, no rinsing.

packaging.zh: 玻璃滴管瓶设计，米白与金色配色，呼应品牌仪式感美学；瓶身信息突出临床宣称与获奖标识（2025 Essence最佳美妆、Women's Health最佳发际线产品）。
packaging.en: Glass dropper bottle in cream and gold, echoing the brand's ritual aesthetic; labeling highlights clinical claims and awards (2025 Essence 'Best in Beauty', Women's Health 'Best Edge Product').

insight.zh: Cécred证明名人品牌可以靠仪式感定位+专利技术命名在高价位站稳脚跟：Biopeptide-5这类专有名词本身就是营销资产，比单一成分更难被平价品牌复制。
insight.en: Cécred shows a celebrity brand can hold a premium price point through ritual positioning plus proprietary-named technology; a coined term like 'Biopeptide-5' is itself a marketing asset, harder for mass brands to copy than a single ingredient.

company.zh: Cécred（Beyoncé Knowles-Carter）
company.en: Cécred (Beyoncé Knowles-Carter)

launch.zh: 2026年3月17日上市（品牌首个造型系列Styling Collection的核心单品）
launch.en: Launched Mar 17, 2026 as a hero item of the brand's first Styling Collection

market.zh: DTC官网 + Ulta Beauty（官网售价US$34，Ulta同价，常有5%首单折扣）
market.en: DTC (cecred.com) + Ulta Beauty (US$34 at both; Ulta often runs a 5% first-order discount)

positioning.zh: 面向所有发质、尤其是做Silk Press的卷发/卷曲发人群的「热激活丝滑造型精华」——定位为凝胶与精华的混合新品类（gel-serum hybrid）：吹风时靠热与张力激活成膜，用更少的加热次数做出玻璃感直发，同时抗湿气抗毛躁，且可洗净还原自然卷度。
positioning.en: A heat-activated silkening styler for all hair types, aimed above all at the silk-press ritual in curly and coily hair. Positioned as a new gel-serum hybrid category: it activates under blow-dry heat and tension to form a weightless film, delivering glass-like straight styles with fewer heat passes while resisting humidity and frizz — and it washes out so natural texture returns.

target.zh: 做Silk Press／拉直造型的卷发与卷曲发人群；担心高温损伤但仍想要顺滑光泽的消费者；佩戴真人发假发/接发、以及做过化学处理头发的使用者。
target.en: Curly and coily consumers who silk-press or blow out their hair; users who want sleekness and shine but fear heat damage; wearers of human-hair wigs and weaves and those with chemically treated hair.

ingredients.zh: 水基配方，核心为品牌新技术StemShield Complex（形状记忆聚合物＋植物干细胞脂质＋黑蜂蜜发酵物），配合水解丝蛋白、Thermal Gloss Blend沙漠油混合（西瓜籽油/Mongongo油/野李籽油）、荷荷巴油、芦荟、泛醇，以及Polyquaternium-68与Polyquaternium-11两种成膜阳离子聚合物、瓜尔胶与黄原胶增稠体系。含香精（芳樟醇、香茅醇、香豆素等致敏物申报）。
ingredients.en: Water-based, built on the brand's new StemShield Complex (shape-memory polymers + plant stem-cell lipids + black honey fermentation), with Hydrolyzed Silk, a 'Thermal Gloss Blend' of desert oils (Kalahari melon seed, mongongo, wild plum), jojoba oil, aloe leaf juice and panthenol, plus two film-forming cationic polymers (Polyquaternium-68, Polyquaternium-11) and a guar/xanthan thickening system. Fragranced (linalool, citronellol, coumarin and other declared allergens).

evidence.zh: 官方宣称450°F/232°C耐热保护与抗湿气防护，标注为「专利申请中」的StemShield Complex；官网提供「有/无StemShield Complex」的对比视觉。截至2026年7月官网评分4.8/5（66条评价），100%推荐率。未见公开的仪器测量方法、样本量或对照组设计，属于品牌自述宣称层级。
evidence.en: Brand claims 450°F/232°C heat protection and humidity protection from a patent-pending StemShield Complex, illustrated with a with/without visual on the PDP. As of Jul 2026 the official page shows 4.8/5 from 66 reviews with a 100% recommend rate. No instrumental protocol, sample size or control design is published — these remain brand-level claims.

experience.zh: 泵头质地，轻盈不压发。用法要求严格：必须在洗净的湿发上分4区使用，每区2泵、梳匀后立刻带张力吹干，中途变干需补水雾；全干后再用夹板定型。品牌明确提示「必须按步骤操作」，操作门槛高于普通热防护喷雾。
experience.en: A pump gel-serum that stays lightweight and does not weigh hair down. Usage is strict: apply to clean damp hair in 4 sections, 2 pumps per section, comb through, then blow-dry that section immediately with tension; re-mist if a section dries out, and flat-iron only once fully dry. The brand explicitly warns that exact steps must be followed — a higher execution barrier than a standard heat-protectant spray.

packaging.zh: 5 fl oz泵头瓶，延续品牌米白＋金色仪式感视觉；单笔订单限购5件。造型系列共7个SKU，与Thermal Shield Mist（US$30）、Strong Hold Gel（US$32）等构成可叠加的「不堆积」造型组合。
packaging.en: A 5 fl oz pump bottle in the brand's cream-and-gold ritual aesthetic; capped at 5 units per order. It sits in a 7-SKU styling collection alongside Thermal Shield Mist (US$30) and Strong Hold Gel (US$32), designed to layer without buildup.

insight.zh: 这支产品把「热损伤」从风险话术转成了可购买的性能承诺：同类产品通常停留在提醒减少热工具使用，它则承诺用更少的加热次数达成同样效果——对做Silk Press的消费者来说，减少加热次数本身就是护发。对我们的启示是，热防护品类的价值主张可以从「防护率数字」转向「减少操作次数」这种消费者能直接感知的效率语言；同时Cécred用专有技术命名（StemShield Complex）把一组常规成膜聚合物＋油脂包装成不可复制的资产，这与Biopeptide-5是同一套做法。
insight.en: This product converts heat damage from a risk message into a purchasable performance promise: where comparable products stop at advising less heat use, it promises the same result with fewer passes — and for silk-press users, fewer passes is itself hair care. The takeaway is that heat-protection propositions can shift from protection percentages to an efficiency language consumers feel directly. Cécred also repeats the same approach it used for Biopeptide-5, packaging a fairly conventional film-former-plus-oil system as a proprietary, hard-to-copy asset named StemShield Complex.

ingredientsNote.zh: 配方为水/甘油基底，辅以荷荷巴油、芦荟汁、泛醇与瓜尔胶·黄原胶体系。含香精并申报芳樟醇、香茅醇、香豆素、乙酸芳樟酯等致敏成分，敏感头皮需留意。整体成分表并不罕见——真正的差异在于技术命名与用法设计，而非单一新成分。
ingredientsNote.en: A water/glycerin base rounded out with jojoba oil, aloe juice, panthenol and a guar/xanthan system. It is fragranced, with linalool, citronellol, coumarin and linalyl acetate declared — worth noting for sensitive scalps. The INCI itself is not unusual; the differentiation lies in the naming of the technology and the prescribed application ritual, not in a single novel ingredient.

en.title: StemShield Complex (patent-pending)
en.desc: Bundles shape-memory polymers, plant stem-cell lipids and black honey fermentation into one named barrier-protection technology that anchors the whole styling collection rather than a single SKU.

en.title: Dual heat-and-tension activation
en.desc: The formula does not set on application; it is activated by blow-dryer heat together with comb or round-brush tension, which is why sectioning, immediate drying and re-misting are written as mandatory steps.

en.title: Reversible, washes-out styling strategy
en.desc: Deliberately engineered to rinse out and let curl return, separating 'styling' from 'chemical straightening' and lowering the fear of permanently altering hair.

en.title: Collection-level layering validation
en.desc: All 7 styling SKUs were developed against a shared 'layer without buildup' requirement, so the unit of technical evaluation is the routine, not the product.

company.zh: Bottle Works
company.en: Bottle Works

launch.en: September 13, 2023

market.zh: 日本药妆、电商及生活方式零售
market.en: Japanese drugstores, e-commerce and lifestyle retail

capacity.zh: 本体 450 mL / 替换装 400 mL

positioning.zh: 围绕“貯水リペア”和“蜜髪”构建光泽修护定位。产品把有机麦卢卡蜂蜜的保水故事、三种胶原蛋白的空洞损伤修护、角质层护理和热保护整合在一起，主打毛躁、粗硬、内部空洞化和光泽不足。
positioning.en: Positioned around water-retention repair and glossy “honey hair.” Organic Manuka honey, three collagen types, cuticle care and heat protection are combined to address frizz, coarse texture, internal hollow damage and lack of shine.

target.zh: 主要面向染烫、吹风和夹板使用频繁、发丝干燥粗糙、缺乏光泽及难以服帖的人群。视觉和香味偏女性化，但官方没有严格限定年龄。
target.en: For consumers with color, perm and heat-tool damage who experience dryness, roughness, poor shine and difficult manageability. The visual and fragrance direction is feminine, though the brand does not impose a strict age limit.

distribution.zh: 本体 450 mL / ¥1,650；替换装 400 mL / ¥1,210。属于日本大众高机能洗护的主流价位。药妆和电商是核心渠道，替换装有利于维持复购。
distribution.en: 450 mL at ¥1,650 and a 400 mL refill at ¥1,210. It occupies the mainstream Japanese mass-premium haircare price band, relying on drugstores and e-commerce for reach.

ingredients.zh: 核心故事包括有机麦卢卡蜂蜜、三种胶原蛋白、透明质酸衍生物、神经酰胺、角蛋白和水解丝。官方还提到 γ-Docosalactone 与水解芝麻蛋白衍生物作为热保护相关成分。
ingredients.en: Organic Manuka honey, three collagen types, a hyaluronic-acid derivative, ceramides, keratin and hydrolyzed silk. Heat-care ingredients support a story of retaining internal moisture and smoothing the cuticle.

evidence.zh: 官方公开页面主要提供成分功能、产品特征和热保护成分说明，未见完整公开的人体临床方案、仪器测试数据或样本量。其支撑更偏向成分机理与品牌内部产品开发逻辑。
evidence.en: Official communication mainly provides ingredient functions and product-development logic. No complete public human clinical protocol, instrumental data set or sample size was found.

experience.zh: 450 mL 泵瓶，浅奶油色与蜂蜜琥珀色组合，强调甜润、柔软和高光泽。香型为 Aqua Blossom Honey。护发素定位强调包裹感、湿发顺滑、冲洗后的柔软度以及吹干后的服帖和光泽。
experience.en: A 450 mL pump bottle in soft cream and honey-amber tones. Aqua Blossom Honey fragrance. The conditioner emphasizes coating, wet detangling, softness after rinsing, and smooth glossy hair after drying.

packaging.zh: 柔和浅色瓶身、蜂蜜色液滴与圆润泵头形成明显的甜润感。相比 &honey 的装饰性包装，HONEYQUE 更简洁成熟；相比专业沙龙品牌，则更亲和。
packaging.en: Soft colors, honey-toned details and a rounded pump create a rich but approachable look. It is simpler and more mature than highly decorative honey brands, while remaining more friendly than salon-professional packaging.

insight.zh: 核心优势是把蜂蜜故事从“天然保湿”推进到“发丝空洞化修护”，因此比单纯的蜂蜜香氛产品更具技术感。较容易复制的是成分组合；较难复制的是蜜感视觉、香味、顺滑触感和全系列传播的一致性。
insight.en: Its strength is extending honey from a natural-moisture story into internal hollow-damage repair. The ingredient combination is easy to copy; the difficult part is achieving consistent scent, slip, gloss and visual identity across the line.

zh: 染烫、吹风、夹板等热工具使用频繁人群
发丝干燥粗糙、缺乏光泽人群
难以服帖、内部空洞化受损发质
视觉与香味偏好女性化护理体验的消费者

Dry, rough, dull hair
Hard-to-manage hair with internal hollow damage
Consumers who prefer a feminine visual and fragrance experience

三种胶原蛋白修护空洞化损伤

替换装设计，利于维持复购
en: Organic Manuka honey “water-retention repair” (chosui repair)
Three collagen types repair internally hollowed-out damage
Cuticle care plus heat-protection ingredients
Refill pack design supports repeat purchase

company.zh: Kinky-Curly Hair Care
company.en: Kinky-Curly Hair Care

launch.zh: 天然发社群经典长青单品（早年推出，长期在售）
launch.en: A natural-hair community classic, launched years ago and still a staple

market.zh: 品牌官网、Sally Beauty、CVS、Meijer等美国零售渠道
market.en: Brand website, Sally Beauty, CVS, Meijer and other US retail channels

positioning.zh: 打结今日终结，奶油质地的草本护发素/免洗顺发乳，专为浓密纠结的卷发/紧致纹理发梳理设计，可作冲洗型护发素或免洗使用。
positioning.en: Knot Today (a play on 'not today'), a creamy herbal conditioner/detangler for thick, tangle-prone curly and coily hair, usable as either a rinse-out conditioner or a leave-in.

target.zh: 浓密卷发/紧致纹理发、拆卸编发/延伸发后急需梳理的人群；天然发社群中配方极简的忠实拥趸。
target.en: Thick, curly/coily hair, especially post-braid or post-extension detangling needs; loyal natural-hair community members who favor minimalist formulas.

ingredients.zh: 有机芒果果提取物、有机榆树皮提取物、有机蜀葵根提取物、有机柠檬草提取物、鲸蜡醇、双十八烷基甲基硫酸铵甲基硫酸盐（Behentrimonium Methosulfate）、柠檬酸、苯氧乙醇、天然香精。
ingredients.en: Organic mango fruit extract, organic slippery elm, organic marshmallow root, organic lemongrass, cetyl alcohol, behentrimonium methosulfate, citric acid, phenoxyethanol, natural fragrance.

evidence.zh: 宣称主要基于成分描述与十余年的消费者口碑（天然发博主评测、社群评价），未见公开的独立临床或仪器测试数据。
evidence.en: Claims rest mainly on ingredient descriptions and over a decade of consumer word-of-mouth (natural-hair blogger reviews, community reviews); no public independent clinical or instrumental data found.

experience.zh: 奶油质地，洗发后大量涂抹并用宽齿梳分区梳理；也可作免洗护发素用于浓密卷发。用户反馈滑感极佳但保湿力对干发需搭配其他产品。
experience.en: Creamy texture; apply generously after shampooing and detangle in sections with a wide-tooth comb. Can also be used as a leave-in for thick curly hair. Users report excellent slip, though it should be paired with a separate moisturizer for dry hair.

packaging.zh: 简约塑料瓶身，粉色系视觉与手写体品牌名，走亲和、怀旧的天然发社群美学，识别度高但不算精品化。
packaging.en: Simple plastic bottle with a pink color scheme and a handwritten-style logo, an approachable, nostalgic natural-hair community aesthetic, recognizable but not premium in feel.

insight.zh: Knot Today长期稳居天然发社群必入清单，证明极简、聚焦单一痛点（打结/梳理）的产品，凭借持续口碑传播也能在拥挤市场中长期占据消费者认知，而不依赖频繁的产品迭代或营销投入。
insight.en: Knot Today's long-standing place on natural-hair must-buy lists shows that a minimalist product solving one clear pain point (tangles/detangling) can hold durable mindshare in a crowded market through sustained word-of-mouth, without frequent reformulation or heavy marketing spend.

name.zh: L’Oréal Professionnel Scalp Advanced Anti-Dandruff Shampoo
name.en: L’Oréal Professionnel Scalp Advanced Anti-Dandruff Shampoo

company.zh: L’Oréal
company.en: L’Oréal

launch.zh: Scalp Advanced 系列现行版本
launch.en: Current Scalp Advanced range

market.zh: 全球专业沙龙、品牌官网与授权零售；日本以进口电商为主
market.en: Professional salons, official channels and authorized retail; mainly import e-commerce in Japan

positioning.zh: 欧莱雅专业线针对头屑与头皮微生态失衡人群推出的沙龙级治疗型洗发产品。适合希望获得比大众去屑洗发水更专业、更温和、更具美容护理体验的消费者，也适合由发型师推荐、愿意在沙龙或专业渠道购买的人群。
positioning.en: A salon-grade treatment shampoo from L'Oréal Professionnel, developed for people with dandruff and scalp micro-ecology imbalance. It suits people seeking a more professional and sensorial alternative to mass-market anti-dandruff shampoos, especially those who rely on salon recommendations.

target.zh: 核心消费者是反复出现可见头屑、同时担心头皮干燥、油腻或不适的人群。适合希望获得比大众去屑洗发水更专业、更温和、更具美容护理体验的消费者，也适合由发型师推荐、愿意在沙龙或专业渠道购买的人群。官方未限定性别；产品覆盖干性与油性头屑场景。
target.en: Designed for consumers with recurring visible dandruff who may also experience dryness, oiliness or discomfort. It suits people seeking a more professional and sensorial alternative to mass-market anti-dandruff shampoos, especially those who rely on salon recommendations. Official communication is gender-neutral and covers both dry and oily dandruff.

distribution.zh: 300 mL 与 500 mL 两种规格，主要依赖专业沙龙、L’Oréal Professionnel 官方渠道及各国授权零售。日本并非其最强本土渠道，进口电商价格差异较大，因此价格竞争力不如日本本土药妆洗护，但专业品牌形象和针对性头皮功效支撑了溢价。
distribution.en: Available in 300 mL and 500 mL sizes through professional salons, official L’Oréal Professionnel channels and authorized retailers. In Japan, import pricing varies considerably, so it is less price-competitive than domestic drugstore products. Its premium is supported by professional branding and targeted scalp efficacy.

ingredients.zh: 核心活性为 Piroctone Olamine，用于去屑及抑制与头屑相关的微生物；配方中还可见 Salicylic Acid、Glycerin、Coco-Betaine、Guar Hydroxypropyltrimonium Chloride 等。整体是较经典的阴离子表活 + 两性表活洗净框架，通过珠光剂、保湿剂、调理聚合物及清凉感成分改善专业使用体验。品牌将其放入 Scalp Advanced 的皮肤学活性组合中，与 Niacinamide、AHA、Clay 等系列语言共同构建头皮“skinification”。
ingredients.en: The key active is Piroctone Olamine for dandruff control. The formula also includes Salicylic Acid, Glycerin, Coco-Betaine and Guar Hydroxypropyltrimonium Chloride. The cleansing base is conventional, while humectants, conditioning polymers and sensorial modifiers improve the professional-use experience. The broader Scalp Advanced range frames these ingredients within a scalp-skinification story.

evidence.zh: 官方公开资料给出了较清晰的测试层级：首次使用后“最多去除 100% 可见头屑”为消费者测试；“最长 72 小时去屑保护”为临床测试；另有 44 名受试者、每周使用 3 次的临床测试描述，用于支持头屑外观减少。公开页面仍未完整披露各测试的详细设计、对照组和统计方法，因此适合归类为“有消费者与临床支持，但完整研究报告未公开”。
evidence.en: Official materials describe consumer and clinical testing, including removal of up to 100% visible dandruff after first use and protection lasting up to 72 hours. A 44-subject clinical test used three applications per week. However, full protocols, control design and statistical details are not publicly available.

experience.zh: 轻盈乳霜型洗发质地，目标是兼顾去屑清洁和头皮舒适度。官方建议在湿发与头皮上均匀涂抹，用指腹轻柔起泡后冲洗，油性头屑可先搭配同系列深层净化产品。香气被描述为中性、清新、具有洁净感和专业护理基调。包装为白色专业线瓶身，搭配淡蓝绿色区块和黑色瓶盖，视觉接近皮肤科与沙龙专业护理。
experience.en: A lightweight cream shampoo designed to combine anti-dandruff cleansing with scalp comfort. It is applied to wet hair and scalp, gently lathered with fingertips, then rinsed. The scent is clean, neutral and professional. White packaging with pale blue-green accents creates a dermatological salon-care impression.

packaging.zh: 白色大面积留白、黑色专业品牌标识、浅蓝绿色功能标签，强化“临床、洁净、专业”的视觉联想。300 mL / 500 mL 规格便于区分家用和沙龙需求。优势是专业感强、功能识别直接；弱点是与其他 Scalp Advanced 单品外观接近，消费者需要仔细阅读功能名称。
packaging.en: Large white areas, a black professional logo and pale blue-green functional labels communicate clinical cleanliness and expertise. The 300 mL and 500 mL formats serve home and salon use. The design is professional and clear, although products within the range look similar and require close label reading.

insight.zh: 其真正竞争力是把经典去屑活性 Piroctone Olamine 放进专业沙龙与头皮皮肤学的说法体系中，并用可量化功效、专家共创和更精致的质地完成品牌升级——活性本身是成熟成分，价值来自这套包装方式。最值得学习的是“功能问题—专业诊断—方案组合”的完整路径。较容易被复制的是基础表活和去屑活性组合；较难复制的是全球沙龙网络、品牌权威和成套产品协议。
insight.en: Its real advantage is the way a classic anti-dandruff active, Piroctone Olamine, is elevated through professional salon authority, scalp-skinification language and quantified claims. The active itself is mature; the value comes from how it is framed. The easiest elements to replicate are the cleansing and active system; the hardest are the global salon network, brand authority and protocol-led portfolio.

launch.zh: 品牌奠基性单品，让The Doux获得广泛关注的招牌产品

positioning.zh: 双用途定型泡沫，主打零结块的中至强定型力，既能定义卷发又能抚平直发边缘，强调不结块、不留白屑的专利聚合物技术。
positioning.en: A dual-use styling foam positioned around medium-to-firm hold without the crunch, defining curls or smoothing straight edges alike, built on a proprietary polymer for a no-flake, no-crunch finish.

target.zh: 追求手感柔软但持牢的卷发造型人群，也覆盖需要抚平边缘、抗湿度的直发/编发造型场景。
target.en: Curl stylers who want soft, touchable hold without stiffness, as well as those smoothing edges or fighting humidity for sleek/braided styles.

ingredients.zh: 水、聚季铵盐-55（Polyquaternium-55，核心定型聚合物）、椰油酰胺丙基羟基磺基甜菜碱、芦荟叶、PVP、生育酚乙酸酯、柠檬酸、丝氨基酸、聚山梨醇酯20、乙基己基甘油、Oleth-20、香精、甘油醚-2椰油酸酯、异硬脂酰胺丙基吗啉乳酸酯、苯氧乙醇、苯甲酸、依地酸二钠。
ingredients.en: Water, Polyquaternium-55 (the core styling polymer), cocamidopropyl hydroxysultaine, aloe vera leaf, PVP, tocopheryl acetate, citric acid, silk amino acids, polysorbate 20, ethylhexylglycerin, oleth-20, fragrance, glycereth-2 cocoate, isostearamidopropyl morpholine lactate, phenoxyethanol, benzoic acid, disodium EDTA.

evidence.zh: 宣称主要基于品牌自述的pH平衡配方与聚合物技术描述，未见公开的独立第三方临床或仪器测试数据；获多个行业奖项认可（品牌官网列为award-winning）。
evidence.en: Claims rest mainly on the brand's own description of a pH-balanced formula and polymer technology; no public independent third-party clinical or instrumental data found. The brand cites multiple industry awards (award-winning per the official site).

experience.zh: 泡沫质地，卷发造型时湿发大量涂抹梳理定型，直发造型时少量用于发际边缘吹干前使用；无结块、无白屑残留，风干或吹干均可。
experience.en: Foam texture; for curls, apply liberally to damp hair and comb through; for sleek styles, use a small amount on edges before blow-drying. No crunch or white flaking; works air-dried or blow-dried.

packaging.zh: 黑白撞色瓶身，品牌名与MOUSSE DEF产品名突出，走年轻、街头文化调性的视觉风格，区别于传统天然发品牌的草本包装美学。
packaging.en: Black-and-white bottle design with bold brand and product name typography, a youthful, street-culture visual language, distinct from the herbal-aesthetic packaging typical of traditional natural-hair brands.

insight.zh: The Doux证明技术宣称+文化认同可以在拥挤的泡沫定型剂品类里建立差异化，聚季铵盐-55这一专利感成分命名和黑人及退伍军人创立的品牌故事，共同构成了比单纯功能诉求更强的购买理由。
insight.en: The Doux shows that combining a technical claim with cultural identity can differentiate within the crowded styling-foam category, the patent-feel naming of Polyquaternium-55 plus the Black- and Veteran-owned founding story together form a stronger purchase rationale than functional claims alone.

target.zh: 3a-4c卷发/纹理发人群，尤其是Wash-and-Go造型爱好者与天然发社群成员；追求配方多年不变的忠实回头客。

ingredients.zh: 水、甘油、芦荟叶汁、荷荷巴籽油、水解小麦蛋白、蜀葵根提取物、荨麻提取物、木贼（问荆）提取物、维生素E、苯氧乙醇、乙基己基甘油、香精。
ingredients.en: Water, glycerin, aloe vera leaf juice, jojoba seed oil, hydrolyzed wheat protein, marshmallow root extract, nettle extract, horsetail extract, vitamin E, phenoxyethanol, ethylhexylglycerin, fragrance.

evidence.zh: 宣称主要基于成分传统功效描述（芦荟舒缓、木贼强健、荨麻刺激头皮）与长期消费者口碑，未见公开的独立临床测试数据。

experience.zh: 啫喱质地，湿发涂抹后手指梳理定型，风干或用扩散器吹干；官方建议可与同品牌Supercurl、Extra Butter等叠加使用以增强保湿。

insight.zh: Curly Magic的案例说明：天然发社群对配方一致性极度敏感，品牌曾调整配方引发用户强烈反弹，最终回归原版才挽回忠诚度，这是社群驱动型品牌管理产品变更时的重要警示。
insight.en: The Curly Magic case shows how sensitive the natural-hair community is to formula consistency, a past reformulation triggered strong backlash, and only reverting to the original formula restored loyalty. A cautionary example for community-driven brands managing product changes.

company.en: OUAI (founded by Jen Atkin; acquired by Procter & Gamble in Jan 2022)

launch.en: Brand founded 2016; this SKU has been on sale since 2020 and is an evergreen bestseller

market.en: DTC + Sephora + Ulta; four sizes (3/10/16/32 oz) spanning trial to household refill

price.zh: US$34（正装）/ US$16（旅行装）；订阅立减10%
price.en: US$34 full size / US$16 travel; 10% off with subscription

positioning.zh: 以苹果醋为核心概念的高端清洁洗发水，定位为「每周一次的重置」而非日常洗发水：面向频繁使用干洗喷雾、造型品堆积、硬水地区的都市消费者，主打去除残留同时靠水解角蛋白保留强韧感。
positioning.en: A prestige clarifying shampoo built around an apple-cider-vinegar concept, positioned as a weekly reset rather than a daily wash: aimed at urban consumers heavy on dry shampoo, styling buildup and hard water, promising to strip residue while hydrolyzed keratin keeps hair feeling strong.

target.zh: 频繁使用干洗喷雾和造型品的都市消费者；硬水地区居民；头皮易出油、发丝暗沉的人群；被名人造型师背书吸引的年轻女性。
target.en: City consumers who lean on dry shampoo and styling products; people in hard-water areas; oily scalps and dull-looking hair; younger women drawn in by celebrity-stylist credibility.

ingredients.zh: 清洁体系为Sodium C14-16 Olefin Sulfonate（主表活）＋Sodium Lauroyl Methyl Isethionate＋Cocamidopropyl Betaine＋Decyl Glucoside的复配，属中强清洁；含Vinegar（醋）承接「苹果醋」概念，Hydrolyzed Keratin提供修护感，另有甘油、Polyquaternium-7调理。含香精（芳樟醇、香茅醇）与三种色素（Red 4 / Yellow 5 / Green 5）。标榜无Paraben、无邻苯二甲酸盐、无SLS/SLES、无麸质、不做动物实验。
ingredients.en: A medium-strong cleansing system of Sodium C14-16 Olefin Sulfonate (primary surfactant) with Sodium Lauroyl Methyl Isethionate, Cocamidopropyl Betaine and Decyl Glucoside. 'Vinegar' appears on the INCI to carry the apple-cider-vinegar concept, with Hydrolyzed Keratin for a repair cue plus glycerin and Polyquaternium-7 for conditioning. Fragranced (linalool, citronellol) and dyed with three colorants (Red 4 / Yellow 5 / Green 5). Marketed as paraben-, phthalate-, SLS/SLES- and gluten-free, cruelty-free.

evidence.zh: 官方页面未列出量化临床数据，宣称层级以功能描述为主（去除污垢、油脂、造型品残留与硬水沉积）。品牌反而用使用频次指引替代数据：干性发质建议每周1次起步，油性发质可1-2次/周。属于「用法建议＋感官承诺」而非循证支撑。
evidence.en: The official page publishes no quantified clinical data; claims stay descriptive (removes dirt, oil, product buildup and hard-water deposits). Instead of data the brand offers frequency guidance — start at once a week for dry hair, 1-2x weekly for oily hair. This is a usage-guidance-plus-sensory promise rather than evidence-led support.

experience.zh: 浓缩配方，一元硬币大小即可起泡；用法要求涂抹于头皮后停留1-3分钟再冲洗，最后冷水冲洗闭合毛鳞片。香型为Melrose Place（香槟、粉胡椒、荔枝＋牡丹玫瑰＋琥珀檀香），香气是OUAI最被讨论的记忆点之一。
experience.en: A concentrated formula that lathers from a quarter-sized amount; instructions call for applying at the scalp, leaving on 1-3 minutes, then a cold-water rinse to close the cuticle. Scented in Melrose Place (champagne, pink peppercorn, lychee over peony and rose, on amber and sandalwood) — the fragrance is one of the most-discussed things about OUAI.

packaging.zh: 绿色半透明瓶身与极简无衬线字体，是货架上高辨识度的品牌资产；瓶身标注可完全回收。四规格阶梯（3/10/16/32 oz）把试用装与家庭补充装同时纳入，补充装同时服务环保宣称与客单价。
packaging.en: A green translucent bottle with minimal sans-serif type — a highly recognizable shelf asset — labeled fully recyclable. The four-size ladder (3/10/16/32 oz) covers trial through household refill, with the refill serving both the sustainability claim and basket size.

insight.zh: 这支产品说明清洁洗发水可以靠「场景频次」而不是「成分强度」来卖：OUAI没有给任何量化数据，却用「干洗喷雾用多了之后的重置」这一具体生活场景，把一个本质上是常规阴离子表活配方的产品卖到US$34。对我们的启示是——清洁类产品的溢价来源正在从配方转向使用仪式与嗅觉记忆；同时也要注意，含合成色素在成分党社群中已成为该产品最常被攻击的点。
insight.en: This product shows a clarifying shampoo can be sold on occasion and frequency rather than ingredient strength: OUAI publishes no numbers, yet sells what is essentially a conventional anionic surfactant system at US$34 by owning one concrete life moment — the reset after a dry-shampoo binge. The lesson is that premium in the cleansing category is migrating from formula to ritual and scent memory. Worth noting on the risk side: the synthetic colorants are now the single most attacked point among ingredient-literate consumers.

ingredientsNote.en: Note that the apple cider vinegar sits low on the INCI and functions mainly as communication; the actual cleansing comes from the olefin sulfonate system. The formula also carries three synthetic colorants (Red 4 / Yellow 5 / Green 5) purely to keep the liquid visually on-brand inside the green bottle — an obvious reputational exposure in today's ingredient-transparency climate.

company.zh: The Doux（创始人Maya Smith，黑人及退伍军人创立，总部美国乔治亚州Macon）
company.en: The Doux (founded by Maya Smith; Black- and veteran-owned, based in Macon, Georgia)

launch.zh: 2024年2月上市，属品牌Classics系列的清洁位产品
launch.en: Launched Feb 2024 as the clarifying slot in the brand's Classics line

market.zh: 品牌官网 + Target + Sally Beauty + Amazon；英国等地有本地经销商
market.en: Brand DTC + Target + Sally Beauty + Amazon; local distributors in markets such as the UK

positioning.zh: 面向卷发与天然发人群的「不剥夺式深层清洁」洗发水：明确针对造型品堆积、油脂残留导致卷型塌陷的问题，主张洗到「squeaky clean」但仍保持柔软，是护理循环中的重置步骤而非日常洗发水。
positioning.en: A non-stripping deep-cleanse shampoo for curly and natural hair: explicitly aimed at product buildup and oil residue that flatten curl definition, promising squeaky-clean without the harsh strip. It is the reset step in a routine, not the daily wash.

target.zh: 卷发·卷曲发人群，尤其大量使用发油、发蜡、慕斯等造型品者；卷型因残留而失去弹性和定义度的人；寻找沙龙级但价格亲和产品的黑人消费者。
target.en: Curly and coily consumers, especially heavy users of oils, butters and mousses; those whose curl definition and bounce have collapsed under residue; Black consumers seeking salon-grade performance at an accessible price.

ingredients.zh: 清洁体系为Sodium C14-16 Olefin Sulfonate＋Cocamidopropyl Betaine的经典双表活组合，配方极简（仅约15个成分）：含PEG-6 Caprylic/Capric Glycerides增溶、Polyquaternium-10调理、洋甘菊与迷迭香叶提取物、维生素E乙酸酯（Tocopheryl Acetate）、甘油。不含硅油与蛋白质。
ingredients.en: A classic two-surfactant system of Sodium C14-16 Olefin Sulfonate plus Cocamidopropyl Betaine in a notably short INCI (about 15 ingredients): PEG-6 Caprylic/Capric Glycerides as solubilizer, Polyquaternium-10 for conditioning, chamomile and rosemary leaf extracts, tocopheryl acetate and glycerin. No silicones, no protein.

evidence.zh: 无量化临床数据，宣称建立在「沙龙实测（salon tested）」与「stylist created」的从业者背书上——品牌创始人本人是持证美容师并经营沙龙，配方经真实客户操作检验。这是一种以专业实践替代实验室数据的证据策略，在天然发社群中可信度高于数字。
evidence.en: No quantified clinical data; the claim base rests on practitioner endorsement — 'salon tested' and 'stylist created'. The founder is a licensed cosmetologist running her own salon, so formulas are validated against real clients. This substitutes professional practice for lab data, and in the natural-hair community that carries more credibility than numbers.

experience.zh: 泡沫丰富，冲洗后有明确的「干净感」但不发涩发硬；配方无硅油无蛋白，避免了蛋白过载导致的僵硬。因主表活为烯烃磺酸盐，属真正的clarifying强度，品牌建议作为周期性重置而非每次洗发使用。
experience.en: A generous lather that leaves a clearly 'clean' feel without squeaky drag or stiffness; being silicone- and protein-free it avoids the rigidity of protein overload. Because the primary surfactant is an olefin sulfonate this is a genuinely clarifying strength, and the brand frames it as a periodic reset rather than every wash.

packaging.zh: 12 oz瓶装，采用品牌标志性的高饱和度色块与街头风字体；产品全部以90年代嘻哈歌曲命名（BREAKDOWN、Mousse Def、Chief Rocka、Bananas），命名体系本身就是品牌资产与社群识别码。
packaging.en: A 12 oz bottle in the brand's signature high-saturation color blocking and street-style type. Every product is named after a 90s hip-hop reference (BREAKDOWN, Mousse Def, Chief Rocka, Bananas) — the naming system is itself a brand asset and an in-group signal.

insight.zh: The Doux证明了在天然发品类，文化归属可以直接替代技术宣称：同价位竞品在拼活性炭、氨基酸表活，而BREAKDOWN用一张只有15个成分的极简配方＋90年代嘻哈命名体系，靠「这个品牌懂我的头发和我的文化」完成说服。对我们的启示是，面向特定族群或亚文化的产品，命名与语调的投资回报可能高于成分升级；另一面的风险是，纯文化驱动的差异化容易被同族群新品牌复制。
insight.en: The Doux proves that in textured hair care, cultural belonging can substitute directly for technology claims: rivals at this price fight over charcoal and amino-acid surfactants, while BREAKDOWN persuades with a 15-ingredient formula and a 90s hip-hop naming system that says 'this brand understands both my hair and my culture'. The lesson is that for products aimed at a specific community or subculture, investment in naming and voice can out-return ingredient upgrades. The risk is the mirror image: purely cultural differentiation is easy for the next in-community brand to copy.

ingredientsNote.zh: 配方仅约15个成分，是同类中最简洁的之一。刻意不含硅油与蛋白质——这在天然发社群有明确意义：蛋白过载导致的僵硬和硅油残留是该人群最常抱怨的两个问题，因此「不含」本身就是卖点。反面是配方无任何可专利化的技术资产，竞争壁垒完全依赖品牌与社群。
ingredientsNote.en: At roughly 15 ingredients this is one of the shortest formulas in its class. The deliberate absence of silicones and protein is meaningful in the natural-hair community: protein-overload stiffness and silicone residue are that audience's two most common complaints, so 'without' is itself the selling point. The flip side is that the formula holds no patentable technology asset — the competitive barrier is entirely brand and community.

company.zh: Olaplex Holdings, Inc.（NASDAQ: OLPX，总部美国加州）
company.en: Olaplex Holdings, Inc. (NASDAQ: OLPX, California, USA)

launch.zh: 2018年上市；据Circana为美国高端市场销量第一的洗发水（2024年1-12月）
launch.en: Launched 2018; the US #1 prestige shampoo by Circana (Jan-Dec 2024)

market.zh: 沙龙专业渠道 + Sephora/Ulta + 品牌DTC + Amazon；全球多市场本地站点
market.en: Professional salon channel + Sephora/Ulta + brand DTC + Amazon, with localized sites across global markets

capacity.zh: 250 mL / 8.5 fl oz（另有100 mL、1000 mL、2000 mL Jumbo）
capacity.en: 250 mL / 8.5 fl oz (also 100 mL, 1000 mL and 2000 mL jumbo)

positioning.zh: 键结修护品类的定义者，面向中至粗发质、各种卷度与孔隙度的受损发：以专利分子在分子层面重建二硫键，把「一次清洗即修复日常损伤」作为核心承诺，是从沙龙后台走向家用日常的旗舰洗发水。
positioning.en: The product that defined bond maintenance. Aimed at damaged hair from medium to coarse across all curl patterns and porosities, it rebuilds disulfide bonds at the molecular level and promises to repair everyday damage in a single wash — the flagship shampoo that carried bond repair from the salon backroom into daily home use.

target.zh: 染烫、漂发等化学处理后受损人群；频繁热造型者；追求「洗护即修护」而非额外护理步骤的消费者；沙龙客户的家庭延续护理。
target.en: Consumers with chemical damage from color, perming or bleaching; frequent heat stylists; those who want repair built into washing rather than as an extra step; salon clients continuing treatment at home.

ingredients.zh: 核心为专利分子Bis-Aminopropyl Diglycol Dimaleate（OLAPLEX Bond Building Technology）。清洁体系刻意避开SLS/SLES，采用Sodium Lauroyl Methyl Isethionate、Potassium Cocoyl Glycinate、Disodium Cocoyl Glutamate等椰油衍生温和表活复配；辅以Amodimethicone、Polyquaternium-10调理，透明质酸钠、泛醇、生物素、多种果提取物与向日葵籽油。无硫酸盐、SLS/SLES、邻苯二甲酸盐、MIC/MIT、Paraben；纯素、染发安全。
ingredients.en: Built on the patented Bis-Aminopropyl Diglycol Dimaleate (OLAPLEX Bond Building Technology). The cleansing base deliberately avoids SLS/SLES, using coconut-derived mild surfactants such as Sodium Lauroyl Methyl Isethionate, Potassium Cocoyl Glycinate and Disodium Cocoyl Glutamate, with amodimethicone and Polyquaternium-10 for conditioning plus sodium hyaluronate, panthenol, biotin, several fruit extracts and sunflower seed oil. Free of sulfates, SLS/SLES, phthalates, MIC/MIT and parabens; vegan and color-safe.

evidence.zh: 官方公布量化临床结果：与Nº.5搭配使用时90%更顺滑·更易梳理·更滋润，断裂减少49%，保湿提升73%；皮肤科测试。市场地位引用Circana美国高端市场2024年1-12月数据。需要注意的是，OLAPLEX的临床数据均由品牌自行委托，且2023年曾因用户脱发投诉引发集体诉讼与舆情危机，公司自2023年起营收持续承压（2026年Q1营收9,940万美元，同比+2.5%，全年指引为-2%至+3%）。
evidence.en: Quantified clinical results are published: used as a system with Nº.5, 90% smoother, better detangling and more conditioned, 49% less breakage and 73% more hydration; dermatologist tested. Market position cites Circana US prestige data for Jan-Dec 2024. Two caveats: all clinical data is brand-commissioned, and a 2023 class action over consumer hair-loss complaints triggered a reputational crisis. Revenue has been under pressure since — Q1 2026 net sales were US$99.4M (+2.5% YoY) against full-year guidance of -2% to +3%.

experience.zh: 高浓缩配方，250 mL标称可用约100次（按2.5 mL/次计）。泡沫丰富但不涩，洗后不留厚重感。品牌香型为葡萄柚皮、糖渍薄荷、生姜与鼠尾草，香味独特，跨全线统一使用。
experience.en: A highly concentrated formula: 250 mL is rated for around 100 applications at 2.5 mL each. The lather is generous without drag and leaves no heaviness. The signature scent — grapefruit zest, sugared mint, ginger and crushed sage — is distinctive and used consistently across the whole line.

packaging.zh: 极简白瓶＋巨大编号「Nº.4」的编号体系，是护发领域最成功的产品架构设计之一：编号本身承担了「按步骤组建护理系统」的教育功能，让消费者自发追求集齐。规格从100 mL到2000 mL覆盖试用到沙龙后台。
packaging.en: A minimal white bottle dominated by the huge 'Nº.4' — one of the most successful product architectures in hair care. The numbering itself does the educational work of 'build a system step by step', prompting consumers to collect the range. Sizes run from 100 mL to 2000 mL, covering trial through salon backbar.

insight.zh: Nº.4最值得学习的是编号体系：把产品线变成一套有顺序的系统后，交叉销售不需要话术——消费者会自己问「那Nº.5呢」。但OLAPLEX同时也给出了警示：当品牌把全部资产押在单一专利分子上，一旦该分子在社群中出现安全性质疑（2023年脱发集体诉讼），整个品牌无处可退，营收连续多年承压至今。技术壁垒越深，声誉风险的集中度也越高。
insight.en: The most instructive thing about Nº.4 is the numbering: once a line becomes an ordered system, cross-sell needs no script — shoppers ask for Nº.5 themselves. But OLAPLEX is also a cautionary case: when a brand stakes everything on one patented molecule, a safety controversy around that molecule (the 2023 hair-loss class action) leaves nowhere to retreat, and revenue has been under pressure ever since. The deeper the technology barrier, the more concentrated the reputational risk.

en.concept: Bis-Aminopropyl Diglycol Dimaleate, invented by materials scientists Craig Hawker and Eric Pressly, is one of the very few molecules to genuinely create a category in hair care — OLAPLEX redefined 'repair' from surface conditioning to the chemical rebuilding of disulfide bonds, and built the entire bond-care segment on it.

en.title: Category Creation Through a Patented Molecule
en.desc: A single molecule invented and patented by materials scientists let OLAPLEX create the bond care category and hold definitional authority ever since. Before it, repair claims rested on silicones and cationic conditioners acting on the cuticle surface.

en.title: Numbered Product Architecture

en.title: Salon-First Technology Education
en.desc: Credibility was established in professional backbars first, with stylists doing the consumer education before retail scale-up — the prerequisite that made bond repair legible to the mass market.

en.title: System-Level Clinical Test Design
en.desc: Headline data is generated with Nº.4 and Nº.5 used together rather than as single products, which both improves the numbers and structurally steers shoppers toward buying the pair.

launch.zh: 2018年与Nº.4同步上市；据Circana为美国高端市场销量第一的护发素（2024年1-12月）
launch.en: Launched alongside Nº.4 in 2018; the US #1 prestige conditioner by Circana (Jan-Dec 2024)

market.zh: 沙龙专业渠道 + Sephora/Ulta + 品牌DTC + Amazon
market.en: Professional salon channel + Sephora/Ulta + brand DTC + Amazon

capacity.zh: 250 mL / 8.5 fl oz（另有100 mL、1000 mL、2000 mL Jumbo）
capacity.en: 250 mL / 8.5 fl oz (also 100 mL, 1000 mL and 2000 mL jumbo)

positioning.zh: 与Nº.4构成系统的键结护发素，面向中至粗发质受损发：在提供顺滑与易梳理的同时把专利分子带入调理步骤，核心差异化是明确宣称「无蛋白」——直接回应键结修护人群最担心的蛋白过载僵硬问题。
positioning.en: The conditioner half of the Nº.4 system for damaged medium-to-coarse hair: it delivers slip and detangling while carrying the patented molecule into the conditioning step. Its sharpest differentiator is an explicit protein-free claim, answering the stiffness from protein overload that bond-repair users fear most.

target.zh: 化学处理与热造型受损人群；打结严重、梳理困难的中粗发质；已使用Nº.4希望完成系统的用户；担心蛋白过载导致发丝僵硬的消费者。
target.en: Users with chemical and heat damage; medium-to-coarse hair that tangles badly; Nº.4 users completing the system; consumers worried that protein overload will leave hair stiff.

ingredients.zh: 核心同为Bis-Aminopropyl Diglycol Dimaleate。调理体系以Cetearyl Alcohol、Behentrimonium Chloride、Cetrimonium Chloride等阳离子调理剂为主，配合Quaternium-91、多种硅（Divinyldimethicone/Dimethicone Copolymer、Amodimethicone、Polysilicone-15）；护理成分含水解透明质酸、泛醇、磷脂、鳄梨油、葡萄籽油、绿茶籽油与生物素。明确无蛋白，同时无硫酸盐、SLS/SLES、邻苯二甲酸盐、磷酸盐、MIC/MIT、Paraben。
ingredients.en: Also built on Bis-Aminopropyl Diglycol Dimaleate. The conditioning base leads with cetearyl alcohol, behentrimonium chloride and cetrimonium chloride, joined by Quaternium-91 and several silicones (divinyldimethicone/dimethicone copolymer, amodimethicone, polysilicone-15). Care actives include hydrolyzed hyaluronic acid, panthenol, phospholipids, avocado oil, grape seed oil, green tea seed oil and biotin. Explicitly protein-free, and free of sulfates, SLS/SLES, phthalates, phosphates, MIC/MIT and parabens.

evidence.zh: 官方公布：即时减少断裂66%并防护未来断裂，保湿提升91%，梳理性提升91%；皮肤科测试。市场地位引用Circana美国高端市场2024年1-12月数据。与Nº.4相同的局限：数据由品牌自行委托，未公开样本量与对照设计；且母公司自2023年舆情危机后营收持续承压。
evidence.en: Published claims: 66% less breakage instantly with defense against future breakage, 91% more hydration and 91% easier detangling; dermatologist tested. Market position cites Circana US prestige data for Jan-Dec 2024. Same caveats as Nº.4 — brand-commissioned data with no disclosed sample size or control design, against a parent company whose revenue has been under pressure since the 2023 reputational crisis.

experience.zh: 质地浓稠奶霜状但冲洗后不压发；250 mL标称约50次用量（5 mL/次），单次用量是Nº.4的两倍。停留1-3分钟即可，无需长时间敷用。香型与全线统一。
experience.en: A thick, creamy texture that nonetheless rinses without weighing hair down; 250 mL is rated for about 50 applications at 5 mL each — double the per-use dose of Nº.4. It only needs 1-3 minutes, with no long masking time. Scent is consistent with the rest of the line.

packaging.zh: 与Nº.4完全一致的白瓶＋编号视觉，两支并列在货架与浴室里形成视觉配对，是「必须成套购买」暗示最直接的设计手段。规格阶梯同样覆盖100 mL至2000 mL。
packaging.en: Visually identical to Nº.4 — white bottle, big number — so the pair reads as a set on shelf and in the shower, the most direct design device for implying they must be bought together. The same 100 mL to 2000 mL size ladder applies.

insight.zh: Nº.5最值得注意的是「无蛋白」这一反向卖点：在一个所有人都在加蛋白、加肽的品类里，OLAPLEX把「不加」写成了明确宣称，精准命中了受损发人群反复经历蛋白过载后的真实痛点。这提示我们——当品类共识过度集中在某个成分方向时，明确的减法宣称本身就是差异化空间。另外，官方把Nº.4的关键数据设定为「与Nº.5系统使用」的测试条件，在结构上让单品购买显得不完整，是值得研究的连带设计。
insight.en: The notable thing about Nº.5 is its inverse selling point: in a category where everyone is adding protein and peptides, OLAPLEX turned 'without' into an explicit claim, landing precisely on the real pain of damaged-hair users who have cycled through protein overload. The lesson: when category consensus over-concentrates on one ingredient direction, an explicit subtractive claim is itself differentiation space. Worth studying too is how Nº.4's headline data is defined under 'used as a system with Nº.5' — structurally making a single-product purchase feel incomplete.

ingredientsNote.zh: 「无蛋白」是本品最重要的宣称设计：键结修护人群往往同时使用多个修护产品，蛋白叠加导致的僵硬和断裂是高频抱怨，因此在护发素这一必用步骤上明确无蛋白，实际是在为整个护理系统做风险控制。配方含多种硅，追求无硅routine的卷发人群需注意。
ingredientsNote.en: The protein-free claim is this product's most important design choice: bond-repair users typically stack several treatments, and the resulting protein overload — stiffness and snapping — is a frequent complaint. Declaring the mandatory conditioning step protein-free is effectively risk management for the whole routine. The formula does contain several silicones, so silicone-free curly routines should note this.

positioning.zh: 把键结修护带入免洗造型环节的高浓缩美发油：2-3滴即可，同时承担光泽、抗毛躁、减少断裂与450°F热防护四重功能，是OLAPLEX编号系统里唯一的日常造型型产品，也是全线中最容易被非受损发人群接受的入口单品。
positioning.en: A highly concentrated styling oil that carries bond repair into the leave-in step: 2-3 drops deliver shine, frizz control, breakage reduction and 450°F heat protection at once. It is the only everyday styling product in the OLAPLEX numbering system and the easiest entry point in the line for people whose hair is not visibly damaged.

target.zh: 所有发质；频繁使用吹风机与直发夹板的人群；追求光泽与色彩鲜艳度的染发人群；希望以一支产品同时完成造型与热防护的消费者。
target.en: All hair types; frequent blow-dryer and flat-iron users; color clients chasing shine and vibrancy; consumers who want one product to handle both styling and heat protection.

ingredients.zh: 无水配方，基底为Dimethicone、Isohexadecane、C13-14 Isoparaffin、Coco-Caprylate与Phenyl Trimethicone的挥发性／成膜硅油体系；专利分子Bis-Aminopropyl Diglycol Dimaleate位列第六。护理成分含玉米油、β-胡萝卜素、向日葵籽油、石榴籽油、维生素E与绿茶籽油发酵滤液。无硫酸盐、磷酸盐、邻苯二甲酸盐、Paraben、无蛋白；纯素、染发安全。
ingredients.en: A waterless formula built on a volatile and film-forming silicone system — dimethicone, isohexadecane, C13-14 isoparaffin, coco-caprylate and phenyl trimethicone — with the patented Bis-Aminopropyl Diglycol Dimaleate sixth on the INCI. Care ingredients include corn oil, beta-carotene, sunflower seed oil, pomegranate seed oil, vitamin E and a green tea seed oil ferment filtrate. Free of sulfates, phosphates, phthalates, parabens and protein; vegan and color-safe.

evidence.zh: 官方公布：光泽提升125%（对照未使用本品的漂发）、72小时抗毛躁与抗湿气、断裂减少77%、450°F/232°C热防护。对照条件被明确写出（vs. 未使用本品的漂发），透明度高于同类；但仍为品牌自行委托测试，未公开样本量与仪器方法。
evidence.en: Published claims: 125% more shine (versus bleached hair without the product), 72-hour frizz and humidity control, 77% reduction in breakage and 450°F/232°C heat protection. The comparator is stated explicitly — more transparent than most peers — though the testing remains brand-commissioned with no disclosed sample size or instrumental method.

experience.zh: 极度浓缩，官方用法为倒置瓶身、轻敲瓶底滴出定量液滴，2-3滴即可；干湿发皆可用，热造型前后均可。质地极轻不油腻，30 mL可用数月，实际单次成本远低于售价给人的印象。
experience.en: Extremely concentrated: the official method is to invert the bottle and tap the base for a metered drop, using just 2-3 drops. It works on damp or dry hair, before or after heat. The texture is exceptionally light and non-greasy, and 30 mL lasts months — making the real cost per use far lower than the price implies.

packaging.zh: 透明玻璃瓶展示金黄色油体（β-胡萝卜素带来的视觉色），配合白色标签与编号，是全线中视觉最具「珍贵感」的一支。定量滴取的瓶口设计既控制用量、又强化「高浓缩」认知，是包装参与产品故事的典型案例。
packaging.en: A clear glass bottle showing the golden oil — the color comes from beta-carotene — with the white label and number, making it the most precious-looking product in the line. The metered-drop neck both controls dosage and reinforces the 'highly concentrated' perception: a textbook case of packaging participating in the product story.

insight.zh: Nº.7是OLAPLEX编号体系里最聪明的一步棋：Nº.4/Nº.5要求消费者先承认自己头发受损，而Nº.7卖的是光泽和热防护——不需要承认损伤就能购买，因此成为整个系统最宽的入口。同时它把「β-胡萝卜素带来的金黄色」这种视觉线索直接转化为高浓缩感知，几乎不增加成本。对我们的启示是，修护型品牌需要至少一支「不以承认问题为前提」的引流单品，否则客群天花板会被自我认知锁死。
insight.en: Nº.7 is the smartest move in the OLAPLEX numbering system: Nº.4 and Nº.5 require the shopper to first admit their hair is damaged, whereas Nº.7 sells shine and heat protection — buyable without that admission, making it the widest entry point into the system. It also converts a visual cue (the golden color from beta-carotene) directly into perceived concentration at almost no cost. The lesson: a repair-led brand needs at least one hero that does not require admitting a problem, or its addressable audience stays capped by consumer self-perception.

zh.desc: 以光泽与热防护而非「修复」为主诉求，使不认为自己头发受损的消费者也能进入品牌系统，突破修护型品牌固有的客群天花板。

zh.title: 无水高浓缩配方设计
zh.desc: 完全去水的硅油基底使单次用量压缩到2-3滴，既支撑「高浓缩」的价值主张，也让30 mL的小规格具备数月使用周期。

zh.title: 包装参与浓度感知的设计
zh.desc: 定量滴取瓶口与β-胡萝卜素带来的金黄色油体共同构建「珍贵·高浓缩」认知，几乎不增加配方成本。

zh.title: 明确对照条件的宣称披露
zh.desc: 关键数据标注对照组（未使用本品的漂发），在自行委托测试的行业惯例中提供了相对更高的可验证性。

en.title: Entry-Product Design That Requires No Admission of Damage
en.desc: Leading on shine and heat protection rather than repair lets consumers who do not consider their hair damaged enter the brand system, breaking the audience ceiling inherent to repair-led brands.

en.title: Waterless High-Concentration Formulation
en.desc: A fully anhydrous silicone base compresses the dose to 2-3 drops, supporting the concentration value claim while giving a small 30 mL size a multi-month life.

en.title: Packaging as a Concentration Cue
en.desc: The metered-drop neck and the beta-carotene golden oil together build a precious, highly-concentrated perception at almost no formulation cost.

en.title: Claim Disclosure With a Stated Comparator
en.desc: Headline data names its control (bleached hair without the product), offering relatively higher verifiability within an industry norm of brand-commissioned testing.

company.zh: THE SKINFACTORY Co., Ltd.（韩国首尔，2016年10月成立）
company.en: THE SKINFACTORY Co., Ltd. (Seoul, Korea; founded Oct 2016)

launch.zh: Airy Volume Hyaluron系列（洗发水／护发素双支线）
launch.en: Airy Volume Hyaluron line (shampoo + treatment)

price.en: US$20.90 (500 mL, Stylevana); US$41.99 for the shampoo+treatment set on Amazon

market.zh: 韩国、日本、东南亚跨境电商为主
market.en: Korea, Japan and Southeast Asian cross-border e-commerce

sources: KUNDAL official store — Airy Volume Hyaluron

positioning.zh: 面向细软塌发质与头皮容易出油人群的丰盈型洗发水：用8种形态的透明质酸做保湿，同时靠PHA与水杨酸衍生物清理头皮堆积，把「保湿」与「蓬松」这一对通常互相冲突的诉求放进同一支产品。定价在US$20上下，属于韩系大众线中偏上的位置。
positioning.en: A volumising shampoo for fine, limp hair and oil-prone scalps. It pairs eight forms of hyaluronic acid for hydration with a PHA and a salicylic-acid derivative to clear scalp buildup, putting two usually conflicting promises — moisture and lift — in one bottle. At around US$20 it sits at the upper end of the Korean mass tier.

target.zh: 细软发、扁塌发顶、头皮易出油但发梢干燥的消费者
target.en: Fine, flat-at-the-root hair with an oily scalp but dry ends

zh: 细软发质、发根容易扁塌的人群
头皮易出油但发梢干燥的混合型头皮
偏好韩系香氛型个护、看重香味的消费者
希望免硫酸盐但仍要清爽洗净感的用户
en: Fine hair that goes flat at the roots
Combination scalps — oily roots, dry ends
Shoppers who buy Korean personal care for fragrance
Users who want sulfate-free but still a clean-rinse feel

zh: 8种形态透明质酸复合保湿
AHA・PHA温和去角质，清理头皮堆积
免硫酸盐洗净基剂
专业调香师打造的signature香型
7种海藻提取物与6种植物水解蛋白
en: Eight forms of hyaluronic acid
AHA/PHA gentle exfoliation to clear scalp buildup
Sulfate-free cleansing base
Signature fragrance developed with professional perfumers
Seven seaweed extracts and six hydrolysed plant proteins

ingredients.zh: 洗净基剂为Disodium Laureth Sulfosuccinate配合Lauryl Betaine与Cocamide MIPA，属温和的磺基琥珀酸酯体系，无SLS/SLES。透明质酸以8种形态出现：Sodium Hyaluronate（标注110ppb）、Hydroxypropyltrimonium Hyaluronate（阳离子化，可吸附于发丝）、Sodium Acetylated Hyaluronate、Hydrolyzed Hyaluronic Acid、Hyaluronic Acid、Sodium Hyaluronate Crosspolymer、Hydrolyzed Sodium Hyaluronate、Potassium Hyaluronate。海洋成分包括裙带菜、海带、羊栖菜、Ecklonia cava、石莼、马尾藻、石花菜共7种提取物，另配海水（Maris Aqua）。蛋白部分为大豆、大米、豌豆、榛子、大麦共5种植物水解蛋白，加甘氨酸、谷氨酸、精氨酸三种游离氨基酸与生物素。
ingredients.en: The cleansing base is disodium laureth sulfosuccinate with lauryl betaine and cocamide MIPA — a mild sulfosuccinate system with no SLS or SLES. Hyaluronic acid appears in eight forms: sodium hyaluronate (labelled 110 ppb), hydroxypropyltrimonium hyaluronate (cationised, so it deposits on the fibre), sodium acetylated hyaluronate, hydrolysed hyaluronic acid, hyaluronic acid, sodium hyaluronate crosspolymer, hydrolysed sodium hyaluronate and potassium hyaluronate. Marine content covers seven extracts — wakame, kombu, hijiki, Ecklonia cava, Codium fragile, Sargassum and Gelidium — plus sea water. Proteins are five hydrolysed plant proteins (soy, rice, pea, hazelnut, barley) with glycine, glutamic acid, arginine and biotin.

ingredientsNote.zh: 品牌宣传写「AHA & PHA」，但全成分中只有Gluconolactone（PHA）与Capryloyl Salicylic Acid（水杨酸衍生物，通常归类为LHA），并没有甘醇酸、乳酸这类严格意义上的AHA。这一点在做同类宣称时需要留意合规边界。
ingredientsNote.en: Marketing says “AHA & PHA,” but the INCI list contains only gluconolactone (a PHA) and capryloyl salicylic acid (a salicylic derivative usually classed as LHA). There is no glycolic or lactic acid — no AHA in the strict sense. Worth noting when writing comparable claims.

zh.name: 8形态透明质酸复合物
zh.desc: 从小分子水解型到交联型再到阳离子化型，覆盖不同分子量与附着方式。其中Hydroxypropyltrimonium Hyaluronate带正电，是唯一能在冲洗后仍附着于发丝的形态。

zh.name: Gluconolactone（PHA）
zh.desc: 分子量大于AHA，渗透慢、刺激低，同时具吸湿性。承担清理头皮堆积的角色。

zh.name: Capryloyl Salicylic Acid
zh.desc: 水杨酸的脂溶性衍生物（LHA），亲油性强，针对头皮皮脂堆积。

zh.name: 7种海藻提取物 + 海水
zh.desc: 裙带菜、海带、羊栖菜、Ecklonia cava等，构成KUNDAL区别于其他韩系品牌的成分识别点。

en.name: Eight-form hyaluronic complex
en.desc: From low-molecular hydrolysed to crosspolymer to cationised, covering different molecular weights and deposition routes. Hydroxypropyltrimonium hyaluronate is the only positively charged form, so it is the one that stays on the fibre after rinsing.

en.name: Gluconolactone (PHA)
en.desc: Larger molecule than an AHA, so it penetrates slowly with less irritation while also acting as a humectant. Handles the scalp-buildup job.

en.name: Capryloyl salicylic acid
en.desc: An oil-soluble salicylic derivative (LHA) that targets sebum buildup on the scalp.

en.name: Seven seaweed extracts + sea water
en.desc: Wakame, kombu, hijiki, Ecklonia cava and others — the ingredient signature that separates KUNDAL from other Korean mass brands.

zh.title: 多形态同成分堆叠
zh.desc: 把同一种功效成分拆成8种分子形态同时投料。单看每一种的添加量都不高（Sodium Hyaluronate标注110ppb），但成分表上连续出现8个hyaluronate词根，形成了强烈的视觉说服力。这是韩系大众线常见的成分表设计手法。

zh.title: 酸类分工：PHA管头皮、HA管发丝
zh.desc: 用大分子PHA与脂溶性LHA处理头皮侧的堆积，用阳离子化HA处理发丝侧的保湿，两条路径在同一支洗发水里分工，避免了「洗得干净就不保湿」的矛盾。

zh.title: 香氛前置的产品开发
zh.desc: KUNDAL全线以专业调香师开发的signature香型作为核心识别，Airy Volume Hyaluron也有Blossom Breeze等多个香型分支。对这个品牌来说香型是SKU分化的主轴，功效是次轴。

en.title: Stacking one active in multiple forms
en.desc: The same functional ingredient is split into eight molecular forms and dosed together. Individually the levels are modest (sodium hyaluronate is labelled at 110 ppb), but eight consecutive “hyaluronate” entries on the INCI list carry real visual persuasion. This is a common INCI-design tactic in the Korean mass tier.

en.title: Divided acid duties: PHA for scalp, HA for fibre
en.desc: A large-molecule PHA and an oil-soluble LHA handle buildup on the scalp side while cationised HA handles hydration on the fibre side. Splitting the two jobs inside one shampoo avoids the usual trade-off between a clean rinse and moisture.

en.title: Fragrance-first development
en.desc: KUNDAL builds its whole range around signature scents developed with professional perfumers, and Airy Volume Hyaluron branches into variants such as Blossom Breeze. For this brand fragrance is the primary axis of SKU differentiation and efficacy is the secondary one.

evidence.zh: 没有公开的临床或消费者测试数据，也没有第三方机构报告。可验证的只有全成分表本身（INCIDecoder与Hwahae均可查证，48个成分）与「110ppb」这一个具体数字。品牌宣称中的「AHA & PHA」与实际成分表存在偏差。整体属于成分表驱动型的说服结构，而非数据驱动型。
evidence.en: No published clinical or consumer test data and no third-party reports. The only verifiable material is the INCI list itself (48 ingredients, checkable on INCIDecoder and Hwahae) and the single “110 ppb” figure. The “AHA & PHA” claim does not match the actual list. Persuasion here rests on the ingredient list, not on data.

zh: Sodium Hyaluronate 110ppb（唯一公开的具体浓度数字）
全成分48项，第三方数据库可查证
无临床测试、无消费者测试、无第三方报告
宣称与成分表偏差：标示AHA但实际只有PHA与LHA
en: Sodium hyaluronate at 110 ppb — the only concentration figure published
48 ingredients, verifiable on third-party databases
No clinical test, no consumer test, no third-party report
Claim/INCI gap: labelled AHA but only PHA and LHA are present

experience.zh: 磺基琥珀酸酯体系起泡量中等，泡沫细密，冲洗后不带涩感。定位「airy volume」意味着配方刻意避开重型硅油与阳离子调理剂，发丝干后偏轻盈，但受损发可能觉得润度不足，需要搭配同系列护发素。香型是品牌主打，Blossom Breeze为花香调。500 mL大容量在韩系品牌中属常规规格。
experience.en: The sulfosuccinate base gives moderate, fine lather and rinses without squeak. The “airy volume” positioning means the formula deliberately avoids heavy silicones and cationic conditioners, so hair dries light — but damaged hair may find it under-conditioned and need the matching treatment. Fragrance is the headline: Blossom Breeze is a floral. The 500 mL size is standard for the Korean market.

zh: 泡沫：中等泡量，细密，冲洗顺畅无涩感
干后手感：轻盈蓬松，刻意不留厚重包覆感
局限：受损发单用可能润度不足，设计上依赖同系列护发素
香型：Blossom Breeze等多个花香分支，是SKU分化的主轴
规格：300 mL / 500 mL，大容量为主
en: Lather: moderate volume, fine bubbles, rinses clean without squeak
Dry feel: light and lifted, deliberately no heavy coating
Limitation: damaged hair may find it under-conditioned on its own — the design assumes the matching treatment
Fragrance: several floral variants such as Blossom Breeze, the main axis of SKU split
Sizes: 300 mL / 500 mL, weighted to the large size

packaging.zh: 细长按压瓶身，配色随香型变化，属于韩系个护常见的「香型即配色」设计。500 mL为主推规格，视觉上强调容量与性价比。瓶身信息以韩英双语为主，跨境电商销售时不额外做本地化。
packaging.en: Slim pump bottle with colour keyed to the fragrance variant — the standard “scent equals colourway” design of Korean personal care. The 500 mL size leads, and the packaging visually emphasises volume for money. Copy is Korean/English, with no extra localisation for cross-border channels.

zh: 瓶型：细长按压瓶，500 mL主推
配色：随香型变化，货架上以色块区分SKU
信息：韩英双语，跨境销售不额外本地化
定位表达：视觉强调大容量与性价比，而非高端感
en: Format: slim pump bottle, 500 mL leading
Colour: keyed to fragrance, SKUs distinguished by colour block on shelf
Copy: Korean/English, no extra localisation for cross-border
Message: the visual emphasis is volume-for-money, not premium

distribution.zh: 韩国本土线上为主，日本Qoo10、东南亚跨境电商，欧美通过Stylevana、YesStyle、Amazon等转售渠道
distribution.en: Mostly online in Korea, Qoo10 in Japan, Southeast Asian cross-border, and Stylevana / YesStyle / Amazon resale in the West

japan: Qoo10 Japan为主力渠道，品牌曾公开介绍日本市场进入策略
日本市场以香型与性价比为主要卖点
zh.channelDesc: 不依赖线下沙龙或药妆店，几乎全部销售来自跨境电商平台，渠道成本低但品牌控制力弱

global: K-beauty cross-border platforms such as Stylevana and YesStyle
japan: Qoo10 Japan is the main channel; the brand has publicly discussed its Japan entry strategy
Fragrance and value for money are the lead arguments in Japan
en.channelDesc: No salon or drugstore dependency — almost all sales come through cross-border e-commerce, which keeps channel cost low but brand control weak

zh.concept: KUNDAL以澳洲坚果油为基底，把植物提取物与配方技术结合，做面向大众的个护产品。品牌名取自德语与英语的组合，2016年在首尔创立，以香型开发与高性价比大容量规格快速扩张，是韩国增长最快的个护品牌之一。

en.concept: KUNDAL builds mass personal care on a macadamia oil base, combining botanical extracts with formulation technology. Founded in Seoul in 2016 with a name coined from German and English, it scaled fast on fragrance development and large-format value sizing, and is now one of Korea's fastest-growing personal care brands.

zh.name: 8 THE THALASSO Moist Shampoo（日本）
points: 两者都用海洋成分做保湿的技术外衣：8T是Thalasso干细胞与海洋来源成分，KUNDAL是Blue Marine Complex与海水、海藻提取物
8T把保湿量化成「84%美容液成分」这一个数字（含水），KUNDAL用透明质酸的多种形态与成分种类堆叠，没有可核对的比例
8T用PPT系氨基酸洗净成分，KUNDAL用磺基琥珀酸酯类免硫酸盐基剂，两者都在回避硫酸盐但走了不同路线
8T本体475 mL ¥1,540（约US$10）且有替换装，KUNDAL 500 mL约US$20.90——同为大容量，8T的日本本土价格明显更低

zh.name: &honey Deep Moist Shampoo 1.0（日本）
points: 同为「保湿+香型+高颜值包装」的组合，是最直接的可比对象
&honey把保湿收敛成蜂蜜一个概念并给出50/30/20的配比，KUNDAL堆叠透明质酸形态，&honey的说法更容易被记住
&honey有「头发水分量14%」这一个对外数字，KUNDAL的宣称中没有等价的量化表达
&honey 440 mL ¥1,540，单价高于KUNDAL；KUNDAL以500 mL大容量与跨境低价取胜

zh.name: CeraVe Gentle Hydrating Shampoo（美国）
points: 同样主打保湿，但保湿资产不同：CeraVe用3种神经酰胺加透明质酸讲屏障，KUNDAL用透明质酸多形态加海洋成分讲水润
CeraVe无香精、以皮肤科背书为核心；KUNDAL的香型是主要购买理由之一，两者对香精的处理完全相反
CeraVe 355 mL US$10.99（US$0.031/mL），KUNDAL 500 mL约US$20.90（US$0.042/mL），CeraVe单毫升更便宜
CeraVe的说服力来自品牌体系与渠道，KUNDAL来自香型与视觉，同一保湿诉求下两种完全不同的建立方式

en.name: 8 THE THALASSO Moist Shampoo (Japan)
points: Both dress hydration in marine ingredients: 8T with its Thalasso stem-cell concept and marine-derived actives, KUNDAL with Blue Marine Complex, sea water and seaweed extracts
8T reduces hydration to one number — 84% beauty serum ingredients, water included — while KUNDAL stacks hyaluronic acid forms and ingredient counts with no checkable ratio
8T uses PPT amino-acid cleansers; KUNDAL uses a sulfosuccinate sulfate-free base. Both avoid sulfates by different routes
8T is 475 mL at ¥1,540 (about US$10) with a refill; KUNDAL is 500 mL at about US$20.90. Both large format, but 8T is clearly cheaper in its home market

en.name: &honey Deep Moist Shampoo 1.0 (Japan)
points: The same combination of hydration, fragrance and high-appeal packaging — the closest direct comparison
&honey compresses hydration into one concept, honey, with a stated 50/30/20 blend; KUNDAL stacks hyaluronic acid forms. &honey's version is easier to remember
&honey has one external number, 14% hair moisture; KUNDAL's claims contain no equivalent quantification
&honey is 440 mL at ¥1,540 and costs more per mL; KUNDAL wins on 500 mL volume and cross-border pricing

en.name: CeraVe Gentle Hydrating Shampoo (USA)
points: Also hydration-led, but on a different asset: CeraVe argues barrier through three ceramides plus hyaluronic acid, KUNDAL argues moisture through multi-form hyaluronic acid plus marine ingredients
CeraVe is fragrance-free and built on dermatologist endorsement; fragrance is one of KUNDAL's main purchase reasons. The two treat fragrance in opposite ways
CeraVe is 355 mL at US$10.99 (US$0.031/mL) against KUNDAL's 500 mL at about US$20.90 (US$0.042/mL) — CeraVe is cheaper per mL
CeraVe's persuasion comes from brand system and channel, KUNDAL's from fragrance and visuals — two different builds under the same hydration claim

insight.zh:
KUNDAL值得研究的是成分表的写法。把透明质酸拆成8种形态同时投料，让消费者在INCI表上连续看到8个hyaluronate，说服力来自视觉密度而不是浓度——唯一公开的具体数字是110ppb，量级很小。这套手法在中国和韩国的大众线里很常见，成本可控，且不需要临床数据支撑。

但要照做需要注意合规边界。品牌宣称写「AHA & PHA」，成分表里只有PHA和水杨酸衍生物，没有真正的AHA。在NMPA备案的语境下，这种宣称与成分不一致的写法会直接卡住。可以学的是分子形态堆叠的呈现方式，不能学的是把成分类别写宽。
insight.en:
What is worth studying at KUNDAL is how the ingredient list is written. Splitting hyaluronic acid into eight forms puts eight consecutive “hyaluronate” entries in front of the shopper, and the persuasion comes from visual density rather than concentration — the only figure published is 110 ppb, which is very small. The tactic is common in the Chinese and Korean mass tiers: cost-controlled, and it needs no clinical data.

Copying it does mean watching the compliance line. The brand says “AHA & PHA” while the list holds only a PHA and a salicylic derivative — no true AHA. Under NMPA filing that kind of claim-to-INCI mismatch stops the submission. The presentation of stacked molecular forms is learnable; broadening an ingredient category in the claim is not.

notes.zh: 资料采集日 2026-07-31。价格随跨境平台波动较大，以官方商城与Stylevana为准。
notes.en: Researched 2026-07-31. Prices swing across cross-border platforms; the official store and Stylevana are the reference points.
