insight.zh:
这支洗发水最值得记下的是计数的诚实度。「30种蛋白质与氨基酸」能在成分表上逐项数出来：7种水解蛋白＋丝氨基酸＋22种游离氨基酸，正好30。这与很多品牌拍脑袋写数字的做法不同——计数属实，就经得起第三方核对，也不会在被拆解时反噬品牌。如果我们要用计数式表达，这是应该守住的底线。

但计数属实不等于功效成立。22种游离氨基酸在冲洗型洗发水中的留存量极低，它们对成分表的贡献远大于对头发的贡献。真正决定使用感的是双硫酸盐基剂（清洁力与泡沫）和5种植物油（缓冲干涩）。产品宣传把「蛋白安瓶」放在最前，实际体验是「泡沫丰富、洗得干净」——两者不冲突，但需要分清哪个是卖点、哪个是事实。

结构上最值得抄的是STEP编号。洗发水标STEP 1、发膜标STEP 2，只做两步，且把52 mL小规格定在US$8（低于发膜40 mL的US$11），用最低门槛的单品做入口再向上转化。OLAPLEX的编号体系有十个数字，转化路径长；UNOVE压缩到两步，决策成本更低。对SKU数量有限的品牌来说，两步结构比长编号更现实。
insight.en:
What is worth recording here is the honesty of the count. “30 proteins and amino acids” can be counted straight off the list: 7 hydrolysates + silk amino acids + 22 free amino acids, exactly 30. That differs from brands who pick a number and hope — a true count survives third-party checking and never turns against the brand when someone takes it apart. If we use count-based claims, this is the line to hold.

A true count is not the same as a working benefit, though. Deposition of 22 free amino acids from a rinse-off shampoo is very low; they contribute far more to the ingredient list than to the hair. What actually decides the experience is the double-sulfate base (cleansing and foam) and the five plant oils (buffering the dryness). The marketing leads with “protein ampoule” while the felt result is rich lather and a clean rinse. The two do not conflict, but it is worth being clear about which is the selling point and which is the fact.

Structurally the part to copy is the STEP numbering. Shampoo as STEP 1, mask as STEP 2, only two steps — and the 52 mL priced at US$8, below the mask's 40 mL at US$11, so the lowest-barrier item is the entry and conversion runs upward. OLAPLEX's system has ten numbers and a long conversion path; UNOVE compresses it to two and lowers the decision cost. For a brand with a limited SKU count, a two-step structure is more realistic than long numbering.

notes.zh: 资料采集日 2026-07-31。成分表以INCIDecoder（65项）为准，30种蛋白质与氨基酸的计数已逐项核对。价格取自UNOVE官方全球商城与韩国官方商城。
notes.en: Researched 2026-07-31. Ingredient list per INCIDecoder (65 items); the count of 30 proteins and amino acids was verified item by item. Prices from the official UNOVE global store and the Korean official store.

name.zh: The Ordinary Multi-Peptide Serum for Hair Density
name.en: The Ordinary Multi-Peptide Serum for Hair Density

company.zh: DECIEM（加拿大多伦多，现属雅诗兰黛集团）
company.en: DECIEM (Toronto, Canada; now part of the Estée Lauder Companies)

launch.zh: 品牌护发线的核心单品，长期在售
launch.en: Core item in the brand's hair line, continuously on sale

market.zh: 品牌官网、Sephora、Boots、Watsons、Amazon等全球渠道
market.en: Brand site, Sephora, Boots, Watsons, Amazon and other global channels

positioning.zh: 护肤品牌把整套方法论直接搬进头皮护理的最纯粹样本。免洗型头皮精华，同时搭载6种授权活性复合物：REDENSYL、Procapil、CAPIXYL、BAICAPIL、AnaGain与高溶解度咖啡因。60 mL售价US$24，单毫升US$0.40，把护肤线「成分透明＋低价」的定价逻辑一并移植过来——这是多数护发品牌不敢做的部分。
positioning.en: The purest sample of a skincare brand carrying its entire methodology into scalp care. A leave-in scalp serum running six licensed active complexes at once: REDENSYL, Procapil, CAPIXYL, BAICAPIL, AnaGain and high-solubility caffeine. At US$24 for 60 mL, or US$0.40/mL, it transplants the skincare line's transparency-plus-low-price logic as well — the part most haircare brands will not copy.

target.zh: 关注头发密度与稀疏问题、习惯以成分表判断产品的消费者；已在使用The Ordinary护肤线的用户
target.en: Consumers concerned with density and thinning who judge products by the INCI list, and existing users of The Ordinary's skincare line

zh: 头发变细、密度下降、担心稀疏的人群
习惯以成分表与浓度判断产品的消费者
已购买The Ordinary护肤产品、信任品牌定价逻辑的用户
不愿为香氛、包装、品牌故事支付溢价的人群
en: Thinning hair and declining density
Consumers who judge products by INCI list and concentration
Existing The Ordinary skincare buyers who trust the brand's pricing logic
People unwilling to pay a premium for fragrance, packaging or brand story

zh: 支持头发看起来更浓密、更丰盈
多肽技术＋植物提取物的复合配方
含REDENSYL、Procapil、CAPIXYL、BAICAPIL、AnaGain与高溶解度咖啡因
轻盈免洗、不黏腻
en: Supports thicker-, denser-, fuller-looking hair
Multi-peptide technology combined with plant-based extracts
Contains REDENSYL, Procapil, CAPIXYL, BAICAPIL, AnaGain and high-solubility caffeine
Lightweight leave-in, non-sticky

ingredients.zh: 水、丙二醇、丁二醇、甘油之后，第5位就是咖啡因，第6、7位为Biotinoyl Tripeptide-1与Acetyl Tetrapeptide-3两种多肽——活性成分位置非常靠前。随后是各复合物对应的植物提取物：落叶松木提取物（REDENSYL）、豌豆提取物（AnaGain）、黄芩根＋小麦胚芽＋大豆胚芽提取物（BAICAPIL）、红三叶花提取物（CAPIXYL）。芹菜素与齐墩果酸对应Procapil。另含精氨酸、甘氨酸、葡萄糖酸钙、氯化锌。防腐为苯氧乙醇＋氯苯甘醚。无香精、无着色剂。
ingredients.en: After water, propanediol, butylene glycol and glycerin, caffeine sits fifth, with the peptides biotinoyl tripeptide-1 and acetyl tetrapeptide-3 sixth and seventh — the actives are placed unusually high. The plant extracts behind each complex follow: larch wood (REDENSYL), pea (AnaGain), baicalin root plus wheat and soy germ (BAICAPIL), red clover flower (CAPIXYL). Apigenin and oleanolic acid correspond to Procapil. Arginine, glycine, calcium gluconate and zinc chloride round it out. Preservation is phenoxyethanol plus chlorphenesin. No fragrance, no colourant.

ingredientsNote.zh: 值得注意的是：The Ordinary在护肤线以「Niacinamide 10% + Zinc 1%」这种把浓度写进产品名的方式建立品牌，但这支产品没有公开任何一个复合物的浓度。原因很可能是这6个复合物都是外部授权原料（Givaudan、Sederma、Lucas Meyer、Provital、Mibelle），官网还专门标注「DECIEM与The Ordinary均与商标持有方无关联」。用别人的技术时，它自己的透明度规则也让步了。
ingredientsNote.en: Worth noting: The Ordinary built its skincare brand by writing concentrations into product names — "Niacinamide 10% + Zinc 1%" — yet this product publishes no percentage for any of the six complexes. The likely reason is that all six are licensed third-party ingredients (Givaudan, Sederma, Lucas Meyer, Provital, Mibelle), and the site explicitly states that neither DECIEM nor The Ordinary is affiliated with the trademark owners. When the technology belongs to someone else, even its own transparency rule gives way.

zh.name: 6种授权活性复合物
zh.desc: REDENSYL、Procapil、CAPIXYL、BAICAPIL、AnaGain同时上阵。每一个在单独品牌那里都会被当作核心技术，这里被并列使用。

zh.name: Biotinoyl Tripeptide-1 + Acetyl Tetrapeptide-3
zh.desc: 位列成分表第6、7位。这两个多肽也是Nécessaire与Cécred的核心，说明它们是可采购的通用原料。

zh.name: 高溶解度咖啡因
zh.desc: 排在所有活性成分之前，是配方中占比最高的功效成分。

zh.name: 植物提取物组
zh.desc: 落叶松、豌豆、黄芩、红三叶——每一个都对应一个商标复合物，成分表本身就能反推出配方结构。

en.name: Six licensed active complexes
en.desc: REDENSYL, Procapil, CAPIXYL, BAICAPIL and AnaGain all at once. Each would be the hero technology at another brand; here they run in parallel.

en.name: Biotinoyl tripeptide-1 + acetyl tetrapeptide-3
en.desc: Sixth and seventh on the list. The same two peptides anchor Nécessaire and Cécred, which shows they are purchasable commodity actives.

en.name: High-solubility caffeine
en.desc: Ahead of every other active, making it the highest-dosed functional ingredient in the formula.

en.name: The plant extract block
en.desc: Larch, pea, baicalin, red clover — each maps to one trademarked complex, so the INCI list alone reveals the formula's architecture.

zh.title: 授权原料的堆叠策略
zh.desc: 不开发自有技术，而是把市面上能买到的6个头发密度复合物一次性买齐放进同一支产品。开发周期短、失败风险低，代价是没有任何一项技术属于自己，竞争对手可以完全复制。

zh.title: 以定价而非技术建立壁垒
zh.desc: US$0.40/mL对上Nécessaire的US$1.60/mL。当技术不专属时，唯一无法被轻易跟进的是母公司规模带来的成本结构——雅诗兰黛体系下的DECIEM有这个条件。

zh.title: 命名规则的例外处理
zh.desc: 护肤线把浓度写进产品名，这里改用商标名罗列。同一品牌在不同品类使用两套命名逻辑，因为授权原料的浓度通常受供应商协议约束。

en.title: Stacking licensed ingredients
en.desc: Rather than develop its own technology, it buys all six commercially available density complexes and puts them in one bottle. Short development cycle and low failure risk, at the cost of owning none of the technology — a competitor can replicate it exactly.

en.title: A moat built on price, not technology
en.desc: US$0.40/mL against Nécessaire's US$1.60/mL. When the technology is not proprietary, the only thing hard to follow is the cost structure a parent group provides, and DECIEM has that under Estée Lauder.

en.title: An exception to its own naming rule
en.desc: The skincare line puts concentrations in the product name; here it lists trademarks instead. One brand running two naming logics across categories, because licensed ingredient levels are usually bound by supplier agreements.

evidence.zh: 没有公开的品牌自有临床数据。可核对的是全成分表与6个复合物的商标归属（Givaudan、Sederma、Lucas Meyer Cosmetics Canada、Provital、Mibelle Biochemistry）。这些原料各自的供应商研究数据存在，但那是原料商的数据，不是这支产品的数据——品牌也没有借用它们做宣称，措辞一律是「看起来更浓密」而非功效断言。这种克制在合规上是安全的，在说服力上则依赖消费者对成分表的自行判断。
evidence.en: No brand-owned clinical data is published. What can be checked is the full INCI list and the trademark ownership of the six complexes (Givaudan, Sederma, Lucas Meyer Cosmetics Canada, Provital, Mibelle Biochemistry). Supplier studies exist for each raw material, but those belong to the ingredient houses, not to this product — and the brand does not borrow them, keeping every claim at "looks thicker" rather than an efficacy assertion. That restraint is compliance-safe; its persuasive weight rests on the consumer reading the INCI list themselves.

zh: 无品牌自有临床或仪器测试数据公开
6个复合物均为外部授权商标，官网明示无关联关系
全成分可在第三方数据库逐项核对
宣称措辞一律为「看起来更浓密」，未做功效断言
可引用性：中。成分构成可引用，功效数据不存在
en: No brand-owned clinical or instrumental data published
All six complexes are externally licensed trademarks; the site states there is no affiliation
The full INCI list is checkable item by item on third-party databases
All claims are phrased as "looks thicker", with no efficacy assertion
Citability: medium. The composition can be cited; efficacy data does not exist

experience.zh: 水样质地，滴管取用后直接涂抹于干发或湿发的头皮，按摩后不冲洗。轻盈、快干、无残留感，这是它能作为日常使用品的前提。无香精，因此没有任何香氛体验，与Nécessaire同为无香路线。官方建议每日使用，60 mL约可用2个月。使用初期部分用户反馈头皮有轻微刺感，与咖啡因位列第5的高配比一致。
experience.en: A water-light texture applied by dropper straight onto the scalp on dry or damp hair, massaged in and left on. Light, fast-drying and residue-free, which is what makes daily use viable. Fragrance-free, so there is no scent experience at all — the same route as Nécessaire. Daily use is recommended, and 60 mL lasts about two months. Some users report mild tingling at first, consistent with caffeine sitting fifth on the list.

zh: 质地：水样，滴管取用，快干无残留
用法：每日涂抹头皮后按摩，不冲洗
香型：无香精，无香氛体验
用量：60 mL约2个月，日均成本约US$0.40
反馈：初期部分用户有轻微刺感
en: Texture: water-light, dropper applied, fast-drying and residue-free
Use: apply to the scalp daily and massage in, no rinsing
Scent: fragrance-free, no scent experience
Duration: 60 mL lasts about two months, roughly US$0.40 a day
Feedback: some users report mild tingling early on

packaging.zh: 与护肤线完全一致的琥珀色玻璃瓶配滴管，白色标签、无衬线字体、只印产品名与容量。没有任何为护发品类做的视觉调整——这本身就是主张：这不是一支洗护产品，是一支恰好用在头皮上的精华。货架上它与同品牌的烟酰胺、A醇并排，品类边界被刻意抹掉。
packaging.en: The same amber glass bottle and dropper as the skincare line, with a white label, sans-serif type and nothing but the product name and volume. No visual concession to the haircare category at all — which is itself the argument: this is not a haircare product, it is a serum that happens to go on the scalp. On shelf it sits beside the brand's niacinamide and retinol, with the category boundary deliberately erased.

zh: 瓶型：琥珀色玻璃滴管瓶，与护肤线完全同款
标签：白底无衬线，只有产品名与容量
主张：不做护发品类的视觉调整，品类边界被抹掉
弱点：与同品牌其他滴管产品难以快速区分
en: Format: amber glass dropper bottle, identical to the skincare line
Label: white ground, sans-serif, product name and volume only
Argument: no visual concession to haircare; the category boundary is erased
Weakness: hard to tell apart quickly from the brand's other dropper products

distribution.zh: 品牌官网DTC、Sephora、Boots、Watsons、Amazon，以及韩国Olive Young Global等跨境平台
distribution.en: Brand DTC, Sephora, Boots, Watsons, Amazon, plus cross-border platforms such as Olive Young Global

zh.channelDesc: 以护肤线积累的全球渠道直接带动护发单品，无需单独铺渠道

japan: Cross-border platforms such as Olive Young Global
en.channelDesc: The haircare item rides the global distribution the skincare line already built, with no separate rollout needed

zh.concept: The Ordinary以「把成分与浓度写在瓶身上、把价格压到接近原料成本」重构了护肤品的定价逻辑。护发线是同一套方法论的延伸：不讲故事、不做香氛、不设仪式感，只提供成分表与价格。

en.concept: The Ordinary rewrote skincare pricing by printing ingredients and concentrations on the bottle and pushing price close to raw material cost. The hair line extends the same method: no story, no fragrance, no ritual — just the INCI list and the price.

zh.name: Nécessaire The Scalp Serum
points: 两者共用Acetyl Tetrapeptide-3与Biotinoyl Tripeptide-1，核心多肽完全相同
The Ordinary堆6个复合物不标浓度，Nécessaire只用1个但标明5% Capixyl＋1%透明质酸——少而明确 vs 多而模糊
US$0.40/mL对US$1.60/mL，4倍差价买的是配方策略与品牌体验，不是活性成分本身

zh.name: Cécred Restoring Hair & Edge Drops
points: Cécred的Biopeptide-5同样由Acetyl Tetrapeptide-3＋Biotinoyl Tripeptide-1构成，只是取了自有名称
Cécred有16周第三方消费者研究（1.5倍密度感），The Ordinary完全没有数据
US$56/50 mL对US$24/60 mL，Cécred的溢价来自命名、明星IP与数据，成分层面差距有限

zh.name: Vegamour GRO Hair Serum
points: 同为免洗头皮精华，Vegamour以植物干细胞与「vegan」叙述为主要说法
The Ordinary的成分表完全公开且可逐项核对，Vegamour以专有复合物名称为主
价格差距显著，The Ordinary把这个品类的价格下限重新定义了

en.name: Nécessaire The Scalp Serum
points: Both run acetyl tetrapeptide-3 and biotinoyl tripeptide-1; the core peptides are identical
The Ordinary stacks six complexes without percentages while Nécessaire uses one and states 5% Capixyl plus 1% hyaluronic acid — few and explicit against many and vague
US$0.40/mL against US$1.60/mL; the 4x gap buys formulation strategy and brand experience, not different actives

en.name: Cécred Restoring Hair & Edge Drops
points: Cécred's Biopeptide-5 is also acetyl tetrapeptide-3 plus biotinoyl tripeptide-1, simply given a proprietary name
Cécred has a 16-week third-party consumer study (1.5x density); The Ordinary has no data at all
US$56/50 mL against US$24/60 mL — Cécred's premium comes from naming, celebrity IP and data, not from a materially different formula

en.name: Vegamour GRO Hair Serum
points: Another leave-in scalp serum, built mainly on plant stem cells and vegan messaging
The Ordinary's list is fully disclosed and checkable item by item; Vegamour leads with proprietary complex names
The price gap is large enough that The Ordinary has reset the floor for this category

insight.zh:
这支产品最有价值的地方不是配方，是它暴露了头皮精华品类的成本真相。Acetyl Tetrapeptide-3与Biotinoyl Tripeptide-1这两个多肽，在Cécred叫Biopeptide-5（US$56/50 mL），在Nécessaire叫5% Capixyl（US$48/30 mL），在这里US$24/60 mL还多送5个复合物。同样的活性，单毫升差价最高4倍。溢价买的是命名、数据、明星IP与体验，不是成分。

对我们的直接启示有两点。一是做头皮精华时，活性成分不构成壁垒——它们都是可采购的授权原料，谁都能买。真正的差异必须建在别处：数据、命名、渠道或价格。二是The Ordinary自己也在这支产品上放弃了浓度标注，因为授权原料的配比受供应商协议约束。如果我们打算用「浓度透明」作为卖点，就必须使用自有配方或谈下可公开浓度的授权条款，否则这个卖点在产品上市时会被迫收回。

还有一个反面参考：堆6个复合物看起来诚意十足，但没有任何一项浓度公开，实际上信息量低于Nécessaire的「5% Capixyl」一句话。数量不等于说服力。
insight.en:
The most valuable thing here is not the formula but what it exposes about the cost structure of scalp serums. Acetyl tetrapeptide-3 and biotinoyl tripeptide-1 are called Biopeptide-5 at Cécred (US$56/50 mL) and 5% Capixyl at Nécessaire (US$48/30 mL); here they cost US$24 for 60 mL with five more complexes thrown in. Same actives, up to a 4x gap per mL. The premium buys naming, data, celebrity IP and experience — not ingredients.

Two direct lessons. First, actives are not a moat in scalp serums: they are all purchasable licensed materials that anyone can buy, so real differentiation has to be built elsewhere — data, naming, channel or price. Second, even The Ordinary abandoned percentage labelling here, because licensed ingredient levels are bound by supplier agreements. If we intend to sell on concentration transparency, we need our own formula or licence terms that permit disclosure; otherwise the claim will have to be withdrawn at launch.

One counter-example too: stacking six complexes looks generous, but with no concentration published it carries less information than Nécessaire's single line, "5% Capixyl." Quantity is not persuasion.

notes.zh: 资料采集日 2026-07-31。成分表以INCIDecoder与官网为准，价格取自The Ordinary美国官网（US$24.00）。
notes.en: Researched 2026-07-31. Ingredients per INCIDecoder and the official site; price from The Ordinary US site (US$24.00).

company.zh: Nécessaire（美国洛杉矶，2018年创立）
company.en: Nécessaire (Los Angeles, USA; founded 2018)

launch.zh: 品牌从身体护理扩展到头皮护理的核心单品
launch.en: The hero item in the brand's extension from body care into scalp care

market.zh: 品牌官网DTC、Sephora美国、Cult Beauty、Amazon
market.en: Brand DTC, Sephora US, Cult Beauty, Amazon

positioning.zh: 把护肤品的百分比标注习惯完整移植到头皮的样本。5% Capixyl＋1%多分子量透明质酸＋烟酰胺（维生素B3）＋泛醇（维生素B5），全成分只有17项，无香精，通过美国湿疹协会（NEA）认证。30 mL售价US$48，单毫升US$1.60。与The Ordinary使用同样的多肽，但走「少而明确」的相反路线。
positioning.en: The sample that transplants skincare's percentage-labelling habit wholesale onto the scalp. 5% Capixyl plus 1% multi-molecular hyaluronic acid, niacinamide (B3) and panthenol (B5), across just 17 ingredients, fragrance-free and accepted by the National Eczema Association. US$48 for 30 mL, US$1.60/mL. It uses the same peptides as The Ordinary but takes the opposite route: few and explicit.

target.zh: 头皮干燥敏感、同时关注密度的消费者；对香精敏感、偏好极简成分表的人群
target.en: Dry, sensitive scalps that also care about density, and fragrance-sensitive people who prefer a minimal ingredient list

zh: 头皮干燥、紧绷、敏感的人群
头发密度下降但排斥药物类方案的消费者
对香精敏感、有湿疹或皮肤屏障问题的人群
习惯以百分比判断产品有效性的护肤用户
en: Dry, tight, sensitive scalps
People with declining density who reject drug-based options
Fragrance-sensitive users, including those with eczema or barrier issues
Skincare users who judge efficacy by stated percentages

zh: 5% Capixyl，支持更浓密丰盈的头发
1%多分子量透明质酸，多层次保湿
维生素B3（烟酰胺）与维生素B5（泛醇）舒缓平衡
无香精，通过美国湿疹协会认证
速干水感，无残留
en: 5% Capixyl for denser, fuller-looking hair
1% multi-molecular hyaluronic acid for multi-level hydration
Vitamin B3 (niacinamide) and B5 (panthenol) to soothe and balance
Fragrance-free, accepted by the National Eczema Association
Quick-dry, water-light, no residue

ingredients.zh: 全成分仅17项：水、丁二醇、丙二醇、透明质酸钠、Acetyl Tetrapeptide-3、烟酰胺、泛醇、红三叶花提取物、芹菜籽提取物、绿茶叶提取物、Biotinoyl Tripeptide-1、生育酚磷酸钠、葡聚糖、1,2-己二醇、辛羟肟酸、柠檬酸、甘油。透明质酸钠位列第4，是配方中位置最高的功效成分；Acetyl Tetrapeptide-3与红三叶花提取物共同构成Capixyl。防腐用1,2-己二醇＋辛羟肟酸，属于温和体系。无香精、无着色剂、无硅油。
ingredients.en: Just 17 ingredients: water, butylene glycol, propanediol, sodium hyaluronate, acetyl tetrapeptide-3, niacinamide, panthenol, red clover flower extract, celery seed extract, green tea leaf extract, biotinoyl tripeptide-1, sodium tocopheryl phosphate, dextran, 1,2-hexanediol, caprylhydroxamic acid, citric acid, glycerin. Sodium hyaluronate is fourth — the highest-placed functional ingredient — and acetyl tetrapeptide-3 with red clover extract together constitute Capixyl. Preservation is 1,2-hexanediol plus caprylhydroxamic acid, a mild system. No fragrance, colourant or silicone.

ingredientsNote.zh: 17项成分中有4项是水与溶剂、3项是防腐与pH调节，真正的功效成分只有10项左右。这种精简不是妥协，是策略：成分越少，每一项的存在理由越容易解释，「5%」「1%」这两个数字也就越可信。相比之下，堆叠20个活性物的产品即使标了浓度，消费者也无法判断哪个在起作用。
ingredientsNote.en: Of the 17 ingredients, four are water and solvents and three are preservatives and pH adjusters, leaving roughly ten functional ones. The brevity is not a compromise but a strategy: the fewer the ingredients, the easier it is to justify each one, and the more credible the two numbers 5% and 1% become. By contrast, a product stacking twenty actives leaves the consumer unable to tell which one is working even when percentages are stated.

zh.name: 5% Capixyl
zh.desc: Acetyl Tetrapeptide-3与红三叶花提取物的复合物，浓度明确标注。同样的成分在Cécred叫Biopeptide-5，在The Ordinary混在6个复合物里。

zh.name: 1%多分子量透明质酸
zh.desc: 透明质酸钠位列成分表第4位。不同分子量组合的说法直接来自护肤品，头皮护理里少见。

zh.name: 烟酰胺（维生素B3）
zh.desc: 护肤品的标准活性，在头皮上用于调节油脂与安抚屏障。

zh.name: 无香精配方
zh.desc: 通过美国湿疹协会认证，这在头皮产品里是罕见资质，直接对应敏感头皮人群。

en.name: 5% Capixyl
en.desc: A complex of acetyl tetrapeptide-3 and red clover extract, at a stated concentration. The same ingredients are Biopeptide-5 at Cécred and are buried among six complexes at The Ordinary.

en.name: 1% multi-molecular hyaluronic acid
en.desc: Sodium hyaluronate sits fourth on the list. The multi-weight framing comes straight from skincare and is rare in scalp care.

en.name: Niacinamide (vitamin B3)
en.desc: A standard skincare active, used here to regulate oil and settle the scalp barrier.

en.name: Fragrance-free formula
en.desc: Accepted by the National Eczema Association, a rare credential for a scalp product and a direct answer to sensitive scalps.

zh.title: 以百分比替代技术命名
zh.desc: 不发明专有名词，直接标「5% Capixyl」「1%透明质酸」。用授权原料的公开商标名加自己的浓度承诺，既避开了命名成本，又比Biopeptide-5这类自造词更容易被核对。这是一种把可验证性本身当卖点的做法。

zh.title: 极简成分表作为信任装置
zh.desc: 17项成分让整张表可以被一眼读完。当消费者能读完，成分表就从合规文件变成了营销资产。

zh.title: 医学资质替代临床数据
zh.desc: 没有自有临床试验，但拿到NEA认证与皮肤科测试。对敏感人群来说，「不会刺激」的资质比「有效」的数据更有决定作用，成本也低得多。

zh.title: 品类跨越的品牌逻辑
zh.desc: 从身体护理起家，用同一套「The Necessary」极简语言进入头皮。品牌资产可以跨品类平移，前提是产品逻辑一致——无香、极简、可读。

en.title: Percentages instead of technology names
en.desc: No coined term; just "5% Capixyl" and "1% hyaluronic acid." Pairing a licensed ingredient's public trademark with its own concentration promise avoids naming costs and is easier to verify than an invented word like Biopeptide-5. Verifiability itself becomes the selling point.

en.title: A minimal INCI list as a trust device
en.desc: Seventeen ingredients make the whole list readable at a glance. Once a consumer can finish reading it, the ingredient list stops being a compliance document and becomes a marketing asset.

en.title: Medical credentials in place of clinical data
en.desc: No proprietary trial, but NEA acceptance and dermatologist testing. For sensitive users, a credential saying "will not irritate" decides more than data saying "works" — and costs far less to obtain.

en.title: Brand logic that crosses categories
en.desc: Starting in body care, it moves into scalp care with the same minimal "The Necessary" language. Brand equity transfers across categories as long as the product logic holds: unscented, minimal, readable.

evidence.zh: 没有公开的品牌自有临床试验数据。可核对的是浓度标注（5% Capixyl、1%透明质酸）、17项全成分表、美国湿疹协会认证与皮肤科测试。「支持更浓密丰盈」的措辞属于外观描述而非功效断言，与The Ordinary采取同样的合规策略。值得注意的是Capixyl的功效数据来自原料商Lucas Meyer，品牌未将其作为自己的证据引用。
evidence.en: No brand-owned clinical trial is published. What can be checked: the stated concentrations (5% Capixyl, 1% hyaluronic acid), the 17-item INCI list, National Eczema Association acceptance and dermatologist testing. The "denser, fuller-looking" phrasing describes appearance rather than asserting efficacy — the same compliance strategy as The Ordinary. Notably, the efficacy data behind Capixyl belongs to the ingredient house Lucas Meyer, and the brand does not cite it as its own evidence.

zh: 浓度明确标注：5% Capixyl、1%多分子量透明质酸
全成分仅17项，可逐项核对
美国湿疹协会（NEA）认证、皮肤科测试
无品牌自有临床试验数据
Capixyl功效数据属原料商所有，品牌未引用
可引用性：中高。浓度与资质可引用，功效数据不存在
en: Stated concentrations: 5% Capixyl, 1% multi-molecular hyaluronic acid
Only 17 ingredients, checkable item by item
National Eczema Association accepted, dermatologist tested
No brand-owned clinical trial data
The Capixyl efficacy data belongs to the ingredient house and is not cited by the brand
Citability: medium-high. Concentrations and credentials can be cited; efficacy data does not exist

experience.zh: 水感质地，速干，官方强调「无残留（no residue）」——这是日常头皮精华能否坚持使用的决定性条件，油腻感会直接导致弃用。滴管取用后涂于头皮分区，按摩吸收，不冲洗。无香精，使用时没有任何气味，对香精敏感人群是核心价值。30 mL标注为30日用量，即每日1 mL，用量提示明确，这也是「30-Day Supply」这个命名的用意——把容量翻译成使用周期。
experience.en: A water-light, quick-drying texture, with the brand stressing "no residue" — the decisive condition for whether a daily scalp serum survives, since greasiness leads straight to abandonment. Applied by dropper along scalp partings, massaged in and left on. Fragrance-free, so there is no smell at all during use, which is the core value for fragrance-sensitive users. The 30 mL is labelled a 30-day supply, i.e. 1 mL a day — an explicit dosage cue, and the point of the "30-Day Supply" name: translating volume into a usage cycle.

zh: 质地：水感速干，官方强调无残留
用法：滴管分区涂抹头皮后按摩，不冲洗
香型：无香精，使用时无气味
用量：30 mL＝30日用量，每日1 mL，命名即用量提示
定位：可与其他头皮产品叠加，不冲突
en: Texture: water-light, quick-dry, explicitly no residue
Use: dropper along scalp partings, massage in, no rinsing
Scent: fragrance-free, no smell in use
Dosage: 30 mL = 30-day supply, 1 mL a day; the name is the dosage cue
Fit: layers with other scalp products without conflict

packaging.zh: 哑光米白瓶身配滴管，无衬线小字，与品牌身体护理线视觉完全统一。Climate Neutral与Plastic Neutral双认证，可持续性写在瓶身而非附加说明。整体气质接近护肤品而非护发品，这与产品定位一致——放在浴室洗手台而不是淋浴间。
packaging.en: A matte off-white bottle with a dropper and small sans-serif type, visually identical to the brand's body care line. Climate Neutral and Plastic Neutral certified, with sustainability printed on the bottle rather than added as a footnote. The whole feel reads as skincare rather than haircare, matching the positioning — it belongs on the bathroom counter, not in the shower.

zh: 瓶型：哑光米白滴管瓶，与身体护理线统一
认证：Climate Neutral、Plastic Neutral，印在瓶身
气质：接近护肤品，摆放场景为洗手台而非淋浴间
命名：「30-Day Supply」把容量翻译成使用周期
en: Format: matte off-white dropper bottle, unified with the body care line
Certifications: Climate Neutral and Plastic Neutral, printed on the bottle
Feel: reads as skincare; it lives on the counter, not in the shower
Naming: "30-Day Supply" translates volume into a usage cycle

distribution.zh: 品牌官网DTC为核心，Sephora美国、Cult Beauty、Amazon
distribution.en: DTC at the core, plus Sephora US, Cult Beauty and Amazon

japan: 日本无正式渠道，依赖跨境购买
zh.channelDesc: 以DTC建立品牌语言，再通过Sephora扩大触达，渠道数量刻意保持克制

japan: No official channel in Japan; cross-border purchase only
en.channelDesc: Brand language is built through DTC and reach extended via Sephora, with the channel count kept deliberately narrow

zh.concept: Nécessaire从身体护理起家，主张日常必需品也应该有护肤级的配方标准。产品线刻意保持精简，每一支都用无香、极简成分表与明确浓度说话，把「必需（The Necessary）」作为品牌的唯一筛选标准。

en.concept: Nécessaire began in body care on the premise that everyday essentials deserve skincare-grade formulation. The range is kept deliberately small, each product speaking through fragrance-free minimal lists and stated concentrations, with "The Necessary" as the single filter for what gets made.

zh.name: The Ordinary Multi-Peptide Serum for Hair Density
points: 核心多肽完全相同（Acetyl Tetrapeptide-3＋Biotinoyl Tripeptide-1），差异在配方策略而非活性
Nécessaire标浓度只用1个复合物，The Ordinary堆6个但不标浓度——少而明确 vs 多而模糊
US$1.60/mL对US$0.40/mL，4倍差价买的是无香资质、极简表达与品牌体验

zh.name: Cécred Restoring Hair & Edge Drops
points: Cécred的Biopeptide-5成分与Capixyl高度重合，但用自造名称而非公开浓度
Cécred有16周第三方消费者研究，Nécessaire只有NEA认证与皮肤科测试
US$56/50 mL对US$48/30 mL，Cécred单毫升更便宜，溢价方式不同（IP vs 极简）

zh.name: Briogeo Scalp Revival Scalp Treatment
points: 同为头皮精华，Briogeo主打清洁排毒＋保湿，Nécessaire主打保湿＋密度
Briogeo有「头皮水分提升2倍」的临床数字，Nécessaire没有等价数据
Briogeo含茶树与薄荷精油，Nécessaire完全无香——对敏感头皮是决定性差异

en.name: The Ordinary Multi-Peptide Serum for Hair Density
points: The core peptides are identical (acetyl tetrapeptide-3 plus biotinoyl tripeptide-1); the difference is strategy, not actives
Nécessaire states a percentage on one complex; The Ordinary stacks six without any — few and explicit against many and vague
US$1.60/mL against US$0.40/mL; the 4x gap buys the fragrance-free credential, the minimal expression and the brand experience

en.name: Cécred Restoring Hair & Edge Drops
points: Cécred's Biopeptide-5 overlaps heavily with Capixyl but uses a coined name instead of a published percentage
Cécred has a 16-week third-party consumer study; Nécessaire has only NEA acceptance and dermatologist testing
US$56/50 mL against US$48/30 mL — Cécred is cheaper per mL, with the premium built differently (IP against minimalism)

en.name: Briogeo Scalp Revival Scalp Treatment
points: Both are scalp serums, but Briogeo leads on detox plus hydration and Nécessaire on hydration plus density
Briogeo has a clinical figure — 2x scalp hydration; Nécessaire has no equivalent
Briogeo contains tea tree and peppermint oils while Nécessaire is entirely fragrance-free, a decisive difference for sensitive scalps

insight.zh:
这支产品证明了一件反直觉的事：在成分堆叠已经成为常态的品类里，减法比加法更有说服力。17项成分、2个百分比，消费者可以在30秒内读完整张成分表并判断每一项的存在理由。The Ordinary堆了6个复合物却一个浓度都没标，信息量反而更低。

「5% Capixyl」这个表达方式尤其值得学。它不发明专有名词，而是用授权原料的公开商标名加自己的浓度承诺——供应商的技术背书可以直接借用，浓度又是自己可以负责的部分。相比Cécred自造Biopeptide-5，这种写法的核查成本对消费者更低，对品牌的合规风险也更小。如果我们做头皮精华，这是比自造技术名更现实的路径。

另外注意NEA认证的用法。没有临床数据时，「不会刺激」的资质可以替代「有效」的数据成为购买理由，尤其在敏感头皮这个细分里。获取成本远低于临床试验，但对特定人群的转化力更强。中国市场没有对等的认证体系，但皮肤科测试报告与敏感肌人群测试可以起到类似作用。
insight.en:
This product proves something counter-intuitive: in a category where stacking has become the norm, subtraction persuades better than addition. Seventeen ingredients and two percentages let a consumer read the entire list in thirty seconds and judge why each item is there. The Ordinary stacks six complexes without a single percentage and ends up conveying less.

The phrasing "5% Capixyl" is especially worth learning. It coins no proprietary term, pairing a licensed ingredient's public trademark with the brand's own concentration promise — the supplier's technical credibility is borrowed directly while the percentage remains the brand's own responsibility. Compared with Cécred inventing Biopeptide-5, this costs the consumer less to verify and carries less compliance risk. For a scalp serum of our own, it is a more realistic path than coining a technology name.

Also note how the NEA credential is used. Absent clinical data, a credential saying "will not irritate" can replace data saying "works" as the reason to buy, especially in the sensitive-scalp segment. It costs far less than a trial and converts harder with that audience. China has no equivalent certification, but dermatologist test reports and sensitive-skin panel testing can play a similar role.

notes.zh: 资料采集日 2026-07-31。成分表以INCIDecoder（17项）与官网为准；价格取自Nécessaire官网30 mL US$48.00（早期媒体报道为US$45，现价已上调）。
notes.en: Researched 2026-07-31. Ingredients per INCIDecoder (17 items) and the official site; price from Nécessaire's own site, 30 mL at US$48.00 (earlier press reported US$45; the price has since risen).

company.zh: Aveda（美国明尼阿波利斯，1978年创立；现属雅诗兰黛集团）
company.en: Aveda (Minneapolis, USA; founded 1978, now part of the Estée Lauder Companies)

launch.zh: Scalp Solutions头皮护理系列单品，与同系列洗发水、头皮精华配套
launch.en: Part of the Scalp Solutions range, paired with the matching shampoo and scalp treatments

market.zh: Aveda沙龙与直营店、Sephora、Boots、LOOKFANTASTIC、日本Aveda官方渠道
market.en: Aveda salons and stores, Sephora, Boots, LOOKFANTASTIC and Aveda's official channels in Japan

positioning.zh: 把护发素这一步重新定义为头皮护理步骤。宣称头皮水分1周提升92%、2周提升128%，临床测试32名女性——这是目前能查到的、把「头皮」而非「头发」的保湿做成可测量数字的最强样本。巴巴苏籽油与辣木籽油为保湿主体，配方主张适用于从油性到干性的各类头皮。
positioning.en: It redefines the conditioner step as a scalp-care step. The claim is +92% scalp hydration after one week and +128% after two, from clinical testing on 32 women — the strongest available example of turning scalp, rather than hair, hydration into a measurable number. Babassu and moringa seed oils carry the moisture, and the formula is positioned for scalps from oily to dry.

target.zh: 头皮干燥紧绷但同时需要护发素的人群；对头皮护理有意识、愿意为沙龙品牌付费的消费者
target.en: People with dry, tight scalps who still need a conditioner, and scalp-aware consumers willing to pay for a salon brand

zh: 头皮干燥、紧绷、脱屑的人群
头皮出油但发梢干燥的混合型头皮
习惯避开头皮使用护发素、因而头皮长期缺乏护理的人群
偏好植物来源与沙龙品牌背书的消费者
en: Dry, tight, flaking scalps
Combination scalps — oily roots with dry ends
People who keep conditioner away from the scalp and therefore never treat it
Consumers who favour plant-derived formulas and salon-brand credibility

zh: 头皮水分1周提升92%、2周提升128%（临床测试32名女性）
即刻改善：93%使用者立刻感受到头皮水分提升
温和不刺激，适用于所有头皮类型（油性至干性）
巴巴苏籽油与辣木籽油复合保湿
100%纯素配方，香氛来自纯花植精油（橙花、柠檬、留兰香）
en: +92% scalp hydration after one week, +128% after two (clinical testing on 32 women)
Immediate effect: 93% felt increased scalp hydration right away
Gentle and non-irritating, suitable for all scalp types from oily to dry
Babassu and moringa seed oils as the moisture complex
100% vegan, fragranced with pure flower and plant essences (neroli, lemon, spearmint)

ingredients.zh: 基底为鲸蜡硬脂醇＋山嵛基三甲基硫酸甲酯铵＋双十八烷基二甲基氯化铵，是标准的阳离子调理结构。第5位即为巴巴苏籽油，位置很高。功效层包括穿心莲提取物、积雪草提取物、乳酸杆菌发酵产物、辣木籽油、葵花籽油、精氨酸、锌PCA与乳酸。锌PCA对应油脂调节，乳酸提供温和酸性环境与轻度角质更新。香氛来自芳樟醇、柠檬烯、香叶醇等植物精油组分，非无香配方。全成分共25项，相对精简。
ingredients.en: The base is cetearyl alcohol with behentrimonium methosulfate and distearyldimonium chloride — a standard cationic conditioning structure. Babassu seed oil sits fifth, unusually high. The functional layer includes andrographis and centella extracts, lactobacillus ferment, moringa and sunflower seed oils, arginine, zinc PCA and lactic acid. Zinc PCA handles oil regulation while lactic acid provides a mildly acidic environment and light renewal. The fragrance comes from plant essence components such as linalool, limonene and geraniol, so this is not a fragrance-free formula. Twenty-five ingredients in total, comparatively lean.

ingredientsNote.zh: 这支产品的结构性特点是：它是一支护发素，却把宣称完全建立在头皮上。常规护发素的使用指引都是「避开头皮」，因为阳离子调理成分停留在头皮上可能造成负担。Aveda反过来要求涂抹头皮，并用锌PCA、乳酸、积雪草这类头皮向成分重构了配方，使阳离子基底与头皮耐受性能够共存。这不是营销角度的调整，是配方层面的重新设计。
ingredientsNote.en: The structural point is that this is a conditioner whose entire claim rests on the scalp. Conventional conditioners instruct users to avoid the scalp, since cationic conditioning agents left there can burden it. Aveda inverts that, directing application to the scalp and rebuilding the formula with scalp-oriented ingredients — zinc PCA, lactic acid, centella — so that a cationic base and scalp tolerance can coexist. This is a formulation-level redesign, not a marketing angle.

zh.name: 巴巴苏籽油
zh.desc: 位列成分表第5位。质地比椰子油轻，在头皮上不易形成闷感，是这支产品敢于要求涂抹头皮的前提之一。

zh.name: 辣木籽油
zh.desc: 与巴巴苏组成品牌宣传的双油复合，主张同时滋润头皮与发丝。

zh.name: 锌PCA
zh.desc: 让「油性到干性头皮都适用」这一宣称在配方上成立的关键成分。

zh.name: 积雪草＋穿心莲提取物
zh.desc: 两者都是护肤品中的舒缓成分，出现在护发素里说明配方目标是头皮而非发丝。

en.name: Babassu seed oil
en.desc: Fifth on the list. Lighter than coconut oil and less occlusive on the scalp, which is part of why this product can ask to be applied there.

en.name: Moringa seed oil
en.desc: Paired with babassu as the brand's dual-oil complex, claimed to condition scalp and hair at once.

en.name: Zinc PCA
en.desc: The ingredient that makes the "oily to dry scalp" claim hold up at formulation level.

en.name: Centella + andrographis extracts
en.desc: Both are skincare calming actives; their presence in a conditioner shows the target is the scalp, not the strand.

zh.title: 把已有步骤重新定义，而不是增加新步骤
zh.desc: 消费者不需要多买一支产品，也不需要改变洗护顺序，只需要把已经在用的护发素换掉、并改变涂抹位置。这是转化成本最低的一种产品创新——不与任何现有习惯竞争。

zh.title: 测量对象的转移
zh.desc: 护发行业习惯测量头发（水分量、断裂率、光泽度），Aveda转而测量头皮水分。同样是保湿宣称，换一个测量对象就得到了一个此前没有人占据的数字。

zh.title: 分周期的数据表达
zh.desc: 1周92%、2周128%，两个数字构成递增曲线，暗示继续使用会持续改善。单点数字只能证明有效，时间序列能推动复购。

zh.title: 阳离子基底的头皮化改造
zh.desc: 用锌PCA、乳酸、积雪草重构配方，让传统上要求避开头皮的护发素结构获得头皮耐受性。

en.title: Redefining an existing step rather than adding one
en.desc: The consumer buys no extra product and changes no routine order — only which conditioner and where it goes. That is innovation at the lowest possible switching cost, competing with no existing habit.

en.title: Moving the measurement target
en.desc: Haircare habitually measures hair — moisture content, breakage, shine. Aveda measures scalp hydration instead. The same hydration claim, aimed at a different measurement, yields a number nobody else had occupied.

en.title: Expressing data as a time series
en.desc: 92% at one week and 128% at two form a rising curve, implying that continued use keeps improving things. A single figure proves it works; a sequence drives repurchase.

en.title: Adapting a cationic base for the scalp
en.desc: Rebuilt with zinc PCA, lactic acid and centella so that a conditioner structure normally kept off the scalp becomes tolerable on it.

evidence.zh: 临床测试32名女性，头皮水分1周提升92%、2周提升128%；另有93%使用者即刻感受到水分提升的消费者自评数据。这是本库中头皮保湿宣称里量化程度最高的一组。局限在于：样本量32人偏小，测量方法（推测为皮肤水分测定仪）、对照组设计与统计显著性均未公开，且「提升92%」是相对基线的百分比，基线值未披露——基线越干，提升幅度越容易做大。数字可引用，但需要标注这些限制条件。
evidence.en: Clinical testing on 32 women showed +92% scalp hydration after one week and +128% after two, alongside a self-reported figure of 93% feeling immediate hydration. It is the most quantified scalp-hydration claim in this library. The limits: 32 subjects is small, and the measurement method (presumably corneometry), control design and statistical significance are all unpublished. Also, "+92%" is relative to baseline and the baseline is not disclosed — the drier the starting point, the easier a large percentage becomes. The numbers are citable, but only with these caveats attached.

zh: 头皮水分：1周+92%、2周+128%（临床测试，32名女性）
即刻感受：93%使用者立刻感到头皮水分提升（消费者自评）
样本量32人偏小，测量方法与对照组设计未公开
基线值未披露，百分比提升幅度受基线影响
本库中头皮保湿量化程度最高的一组数据
可引用性：高（需标注样本量与基线限制）
en: Scalp hydration: +92% at one week, +128% at two (clinical testing, 32 women)
Immediate: 93% felt increased hydration right away (self-reported)
A sample of 32 is small; measurement method and control design are unpublished
The baseline is not disclosed, and baseline drives how large a percentage can be
The most quantified scalp-hydration data set in this library
Citability: high, with the sample size and baseline caveats noted

experience.zh: 轻质乳霜质地，官方强调「lightweight」，因为要涂抹在头皮上，厚重感会直接导致弃用。香氛为橙花、柠檬、留兰香构成的纯花植精油调，留兰香带来轻微清凉感——这是Aveda一贯的感官签名，与无香路线的Nécessaire形成对照。40 mL旅行装、200 mL家用装、1000 mL沙龙装三档规格覆盖试用到专业渠道。
experience.en: A light cream texture, and the brand stresses "lightweight" because it goes on the scalp, where heaviness leads straight to abandonment. The scent is a pure flower and plant essence blend of neroli, lemon and spearmint, the spearmint giving a slight cooling lift — Aveda's long-standing sensory signature, and the opposite of Nécessaire's unscented route. Three sizes, 40 mL travel, 200 mL home and 1000 mL salon, cover trial through professional use.

zh: 质地：轻质乳霜，官方强调lightweight（因为要涂头皮）
用法：涂抹于头皮与发丝，按摩后冲洗
香型：橙花、柠檬、留兰香的纯花植精油调，带轻微清凉感
规格：40 / 200 / 1000 mL，覆盖试用、家用与沙龙
定位：可与同系列洗发水、头皮精华组成完整流程
en: Texture: light cream, explicitly "lightweight" because it is applied to the scalp
Use: apply to scalp and hair, massage, then rinse
Scent: pure flower and plant essences of neroli, lemon and spearmint, with a slight cooling lift
Sizes: 40 / 200 / 1000 mL, covering trial, home and salon
Fit: forms a full routine with the matching shampoo and scalp treatments

packaging.zh: Aveda标志性的深色可回收塑料瓶（品牌长期使用消费后回收材料，是行业内最早推行的品牌之一），标签以浅色文字标注系列名与容量。视觉语言克制、偏专业沙龙，与货架上依赖颜色与图形吸引注意的大众品牌区分明显。1000 mL沙龙装的存在本身就是渠道属性的声明。
packaging.en: Aveda's signature dark recyclable bottle — the brand was among the first in the industry to commit to post-consumer recycled material — with light lettering for the range name and volume. The visual language is restrained and salon-professional, clearly apart from mass brands competing on colour and graphics. The existence of a 1000 mL salon size is itself a statement about channel.

zh: 瓶型：Aveda标志性深色可回收塑料瓶
可持续：长期使用消费后回收材料，行业内起步最早的品牌之一
视觉：克制、专业沙龙调性，非货架吸睛型
规格信号：1000 mL沙龙装体现渠道属性
en: Format: Aveda's signature dark recyclable bottle
Sustainability: a long-standing user of post-consumer recycled material, among the earliest in the industry
Visual: restrained, salon-professional rather than shelf-grabbing
Size signal: the 1000 mL salon format states the channel

distribution.zh: Aveda沙龙与直营店为核心，Sephora、Boots、LOOKFANTASTIC等零售与电商补充，日本有官方渠道
distribution.en: Aveda salons and stores at the core, supported by Sephora, Boots and LOOKFANTASTIC, with official channels in Japan

japan: Aveda日本官方渠道与直营店

global: Sephora in the Middle East and Southeast Asia

zh.concept: Aveda自1978年起以植物来源成分与环境责任建立品牌，是最早把「头皮健康决定头发状态」写进产品体系的沙龙品牌之一。Scalp Solutions系列把这个主张产品化，用可测量的头皮数据替代传统的发丝宣称。

en.concept: Since 1978 Aveda has built on plant-derived ingredients and environmental responsibility, and was among the first salon brands to write "scalp health determines hair condition" into its product system. Scalp Solutions turns that premise into products, replacing traditional strand claims with measurable scalp data.

zh.name: Briogeo Scalp Revival Scalp Treatment
points: 两者都用头皮水分的临床数字，Aveda是+92%/+128%的时间序列，Briogeo是「最高2倍/142%」的单点数字
Aveda把数字做在护发素这个既有步骤上，Briogeo需要消费者新增一个免洗步骤——转化成本不同
Briogeo同时主张清洁排毒，Aveda专注保湿，诉求更单一也更清晰

zh.name: CeraVe Gentle Hydrating Shampoo
points: 同为头皮保湿方向，CeraVe用神经酰胺讲屏障，Aveda用巴巴苏与辣木油讲滋养
CeraVe以皮肤科背书与低价取胜，Aveda以沙龙渠道与可测量数据取胜
CeraVe无香精，Aveda把植物精油香氛作为品牌签名，对香精敏感人群方向相反

zh.name: Kérastase Genesis / Spécifique（头皮线）
points: 同为沙龙价位的头皮护理线，Kérastase以专利成分命名建立技术感
Aveda的差异在于公开了可测量的头皮水分数字，Kérastase较少公布同类量化数据
Aveda的植物来源与环境责任叙述更成体系，Kérastase偏向科学实验室形象

en.name: Briogeo Scalp Revival Scalp Treatment
points: Both use clinical scalp-hydration figures — Aveda a time series of +92%/+128%, Briogeo a single point of "up to 2x / 142%"
Aveda puts its number on an existing step while Briogeo requires adding a new leave-in step; the switching costs differ
Briogeo also claims detox, while Aveda stays on hydration alone, making its message narrower and clearer

en.name: CeraVe Gentle Hydrating Shampoo
points: Both aim at scalp hydration, but CeraVe argues barrier through ceramides and Aveda nourishment through babassu and moringa
CeraVe wins on dermatologist endorsement and low price; Aveda on salon distribution and measurable data
CeraVe is fragrance-free while Aveda treats botanical scent as a brand signature — opposite directions for sensitive users

en.name: Kérastase Genesis / Spécifique (scalp lines)
points: Another salon-priced scalp range, with Kérastase building technical credibility through patented ingredient names
Aveda's difference is publishing a measurable scalp-hydration figure, which Kérastase rarely does for this claim
Aveda's plant-derived and environmental narrative is more systematic; Kérastase leans on a scientific laboratory image

insight.zh:
这支产品最值得记录的是它选择了一个新的测量对象。护发行业测了几十年头发——水分量、断裂强度、光泽度——Aveda转去测头皮水分，立刻得到了一个此前没有品牌占据的数字位置。「+128%」这个数字之所以有冲击力，不是因为效果特别好，而是因为没有可比对象：消费者不知道正常的头皮水分提升应该是多少，也没有别的品牌给出过对照值。换测量对象比提升产品性能便宜得多，这是我们做宣称设计时最应该先考虑的一步。

第二点是它没有增加使用步骤。头皮护理产品普遍要求消费者新增一个免洗步骤，转化阻力大；Aveda只是把已经在用的护发素换掉、改变涂抹位置。为了让这件事在配方上成立，它用锌PCA、乳酸、积雪草重构了阳离子基底——这是真实的配方工作，不是话术。产品创新的转化成本，很大程度上取决于它是否与现有习惯竞争。

引用时需要注意限制条件：32人样本偏小，基线值未公开。「+92%」是相对基线的百分比，如果入组时头皮本身就很干，提升幅度自然容易做大。我们如果要做类似数字，测试设计上必须先想清楚基线怎么设定——这既是数据可信度问题，也是合规问题。
insight.en:
What to record here is that Aveda chose a new measurement target. Haircare has measured hair for decades — moisture content, breakage strength, shine — and by measuring scalp hydration instead, Aveda immediately occupied a numeric position no one else held. "+128%" lands not because the effect is exceptional but because there is nothing to compare it with: consumers have no idea what a normal scalp-hydration increase looks like, and no other brand has published a reference. Changing what you measure is far cheaper than improving performance, and it is the first move to consider when designing claims.

Second, it adds no step. Scalp products usually ask the consumer to adopt a new leave-in step, which meets real resistance; Aveda only swaps the conditioner already in use and changes where it goes. Making that work required rebuilding a cationic base with zinc PCA, lactic acid and centella — genuine formulation work, not copywriting. The switching cost of an innovation depends largely on whether it competes with an existing habit.

Cite with the caveats: 32 subjects is small and the baseline is undisclosed. "+92%" is relative to baseline, and if the panel started with very dry scalps a large percentage comes easily. If we pursue a similar figure, the test design has to settle how baseline is set first — that is both a credibility question and a compliance one.

notes.zh: 资料采集日 2026-07-31。成分表以INCIDecoder（25项）为准，临床数字取自Aveda官方与Boots、MECCA产品页的一致表述（32名女性）。价格取自LOOKFANTASTIC英国。
notes.en: Researched 2026-07-31. Ingredients per INCIDecoder (25 items); clinical figures from Aveda's official page and consistent wording at Boots and MECCA (32 women). Prices from LOOKFANTASTIC UK.

name.zh: Briogeo Scalp Revival Charcoal + Tea Tree Scalp Treatment
name.en: Briogeo Scalp Revival Charcoal + Tea Tree Scalp Treatment

company.zh: Briogeo（美国纽约，Nancy Twine于2013年创立；2022年被Wella集团收购）
company.en: Briogeo (New York, USA; founded by Nancy Twine in 2013, acquired by Wella in 2022)

launch.zh: Scalp Revival系列核心单品，系列已扩展至洗发水、发膜、喷雾等
launch.en: The hero item of the Scalp Revival range, which now spans shampoo, mask and sprays

price.en: US$32.00 (1 oz, Sephora list; US$30.40 with auto-replenish)

market.zh: Sephora、Ulta、Target、Boots、品牌官网
market.en: Sephora, Ulta, Target, Boots and the brand's own site

positioning.zh: 把「清洁排毒」与「保湿」放进同一支免洗头皮精华。备长炭吸附残留、茶树与薄荷处理头皮不适，同时宣称临床验证头皮水分提升最高2倍（142%）。这两个诉求在配方上通常互相冲突——清洁倾向于带走油脂，保湿倾向于留住水分——这支产品的价值就在于它如何处理这个矛盾。
positioning.en: It puts detox and hydration into a single leave-in scalp serum. Binchotan charcoal draws out buildup, tea tree and peppermint address discomfort, and the product claims clinically up to 2x (142%) more scalp hydration. The two claims usually conflict in formulation — cleansing removes lipids, hydration retains water — and the interest lies in how this product handles that tension.

target.zh: 头皮干燥脱屑同时伴有产品残留或油脂堆积的人群；不愿为此增加洗发频率的消费者
target.en: Dry, flaking scalps that also carry product buildup or oil, and people unwilling to wash more often to deal with it

zh: 头皮干燥、脱屑、发痒的人群
造型产品残留或油脂堆积明显的头皮
洗发频率低、需要在洗发间隔中处理头皮的人群
偏好清凉使用感与精油香型的消费者
en: Dry, flaking, itchy scalps
Scalps with visible styling-product buildup or oil
Infrequent washers who need to treat the scalp between shampoos
People who like a cooling sensation and essential-oil scent

zh: 临床验证头皮水分提升最高2倍（142%）
备长炭吸附头皮与毛囊内的杂质与残留
茶树精油舒缓头皮不适、改善脱屑
免洗滴管型，可在洗发间隔使用
6-free配方，纯素、无残酷测试
en: Clinically shown to increase scalp hydration by up to 2x (142%)
Binchotan charcoal draws impurities and buildup from scalp and follicles
Tea tree oil soothes discomfort and reduces flaking
Leave-in dropper format for use between washes
6-free formula, vegan and cruelty-free

ingredients.zh: 水之后第2位是金缕梅水，第3位甘油。金缕梅属收敛成分，与保湿诉求方向相反，但它是「清爽感」的来源。功效层包括生物素、泛醇、茶树叶油、活性炭粉、薄荷油、姜根油、芦荟汁、乳酸薄荷酯（清凉剂）、Saccharide Isomerate、透明质酸钠、生育酚乙酸酯。防腐为脱氢乙酸与苯甲醇。含茶树、薄荷、姜三种精油，因此不适合精油敏感人群。
ingredients.en: Second on the list after water is witch hazel water, with glycerin third. Witch hazel is an astringent, running counter to the hydration claim, but it is the source of the fresh finish. The functional layer includes biotin, panthenol, tea tree leaf oil, charcoal powder, peppermint oil, ginger root oil, aloe juice, menthyl lactate (a cooling agent), saccharide isomerate, sodium hyaluronate and tocopheryl acetate. Preservation is dehydroacetic acid and benzyl alcohol. With tea tree, peppermint and ginger oils present, it is unsuitable for those sensitive to essential oils.

ingredientsNote.zh: 「头皮水分提升2倍」这个数字的实际承担者很可能是Saccharide Isomerate，而不是宣传前排的活性炭或茶树。Saccharide Isomerate（原料名Pentavitin）能与角质层结合、提供长时保湿，是护肤品中做长效保湿测试的常用成分。品牌把它放在成分表中后段、宣传中几乎不提，却用它支撑最核心的临床数字。前排讲故事的成分和后排出数据的成分是分开的，这在功效型产品中很常见。
ingredientsNote.en: The ingredient actually carrying "2x scalp hydration" is most likely saccharide isomerate, not the charcoal or tea tree that lead the marketing. Saccharide isomerate (sold as Pentavitin) binds to the stratum corneum for long-lasting hydration and is a standard choice when running long-duration moisture tests in skincare. The brand places it late on the list and barely mentions it, while using it to support the central clinical figure. The ingredients that tell the story and the ingredients that produce the data are separate — a common split in efficacy products.

zh.name: Saccharide Isomerate
zh.desc: 与角质层结合的长效保湿成分，最可能是「水分提升2倍」的承担者。位列成分表后段，宣传中几乎不提。

zh.name: 备长炭粉
zh.desc: 吸附残留的视觉化说法，是产品命名与包装的核心，但在免洗滴管型产品中的实际吸附量有限。

zh.name: 茶树精油＋薄荷油
zh.desc: 提供清凉与刺激感，让消费者「感觉到产品在起作用」。这是感官层面的功效证明。

zh.name: 金缕梅水
zh.desc: 收敛成分，与保湿诉求方向相反，但提供清爽不黏腻的使用感——这支产品在体感与宣称之间的取舍就体现在这里。

en.name: Saccharide isomerate
en.desc: A long-acting humectant that binds to the stratum corneum, and the most likely source of the 2x hydration figure. It sits late on the list and is barely mentioned in the marketing.

en.name: Binchotan charcoal powder
en.desc: A visualisable way to talk about drawing out buildup, central to the name and packaging, though actual adsorption in a leave-in dropper product is limited.

en.name: Tea tree + peppermint oils
en.desc: They provide cooling and tingle, letting the user feel the product working — efficacy demonstrated at the sensory level.

en.name: Witch hazel water
en.desc: An astringent that runs against the hydration claim but delivers the fresh, non-sticky finish. This is exactly where the product trades feel against claim.

zh.title: 矛盾诉求的分层处理
zh.desc: 清洁与保湿在配方上冲突，产品的解法是把两者交给不同成分并在时间上错开：金缕梅与精油负责即刻的清爽与清凉感，Saccharide Isomerate负责测试周期内的长效水分。消费者立刻感受到的和数据测出来的不是同一件事，但两者都成立。

zh.title: 感官作为功效证据
zh.desc: 薄荷与乳酸薄荷酯带来的清凉刺激是可感知的，消费者会把这种感觉理解为「在起作用」。在缺乏即时可见效果的品类里，感官反馈承担了说服职能。

zh.title: 洗发间隔中的新使用场景
zh.desc: 免洗滴管型让产品可以在两次洗发之间使用，创造了原本不存在的使用频次。对低频洗发人群尤其有效，也直接提升了复购速度。

zh.title: 单品扩展为系列的路径
zh.desc: Scalp Revival从这支精华起步，扩展到洗发水、发膜、干洗喷雾、去屑喷雾。用一个成分组合（炭＋茶树）覆盖整个系列，成分复用率高、消费者认知成本低。

en.title: Layering contradictory claims
en.desc: Cleansing and hydration conflict in formulation, and the solution is to assign them to different ingredients on different timescales: witch hazel and the essential oils deliver immediate freshness and cooling, while saccharide isomerate carries long-duration moisture across the test period. What the user feels and what the data measures are not the same thing, yet both hold.

en.title: Sensation as proof of efficacy
en.desc: The cooling tingle from peppermint and menthyl lactate is perceptible, and users read that sensation as the product working. In a category with no immediately visible result, sensory feedback does the persuading.

en.title: A new usage occasion between washes
en.desc: The leave-in dropper format lets the product be used between shampoos, creating a frequency that did not previously exist. It works especially well for infrequent washers and directly accelerates repurchase.

en.title: A path from single product to range
en.desc: Scalp Revival started with this serum and grew into shampoo, mask, dry shampoo and flake sprays. One ingredient pairing — charcoal plus tea tree — covers the entire range, keeping reuse high and consumer comprehension cheap.

evidence.zh: 临床验证头皮水分提升最高2倍。需要注意的是不同渠道对同一项测试的表述不一致：Briogeo官网与Sephora写「up to 2X」，Boots与Target写「up to 142%」。142%的提升意味着最终值约为基线的2.42倍，与「2倍」并不等同，这是同一组数据的两种不同换算方式。测试方法为皮肤水分测定，样本量、周期与对照组设计未公开。「最高（up to）」这一限定词意味着142%是个体最优值而非平均值。
evidence.en: Clinically shown to increase scalp hydration by up to 2x. Note that channels describe the same test inconsistently: Briogeo's own site and Sephora say "up to 2X", while Boots and Target say "up to 142%". A 142% increase means a final value of about 2.42x baseline, which is not the same as 2x — two different conversions of one data set. The method is skin hydration measurement; sample size, duration and control design are unpublished. The qualifier "up to" means 142% is a best individual result rather than an average.

zh: 临床验证：头皮水分提升最高2倍
渠道表述不一致：官网/Sephora写「2X」，Boots/Target写「142%」
142%提升≈基线的2.42倍，与「2倍」并非同一换算

样本量、测试周期、对照组设计均未公开
可引用性：中。数字存在但换算口径需要标注
en: Clinically shown: up to 2x more scalp hydration
Inconsistent across channels: the brand site and Sephora say "2X", Boots and Target say "142%"
A 142% increase is about 2.42x baseline, not the same conversion as 2x
"Up to" denotes a best individual result, not an average
Sample size, duration and control design are unpublished
Citability: medium. The figure exists, but the conversion basis must be flagged

experience.zh: 水样质地，滴管沿头皮分区涂抹后按摩，不冲洗。薄荷与乳酸薄荷酯带来明确的清凉感，是使用体验中最突出的部分。茶树、薄荷、姜三种精油构成偏药感的草本香型，与Nécessaire的完全无香形成对照——这支产品刻意让人「感觉到」它在工作。1 oz容量偏小，按每周2-3次使用约可用2个月。含精油，敏感头皮需先做局部测试。
experience.en: A water-light texture applied by dropper along scalp partings and massaged in without rinsing. The cooling from peppermint and menthyl lactate is pronounced and the most salient part of the experience. Tea tree, peppermint and ginger give a medicinal herbal scent, the opposite of Nécessaire's complete lack of fragrance — this product deliberately makes itself felt. The 1 oz size is small, lasting about two months at two or three uses a week. It contains essential oils, so sensitive scalps should patch test.

The dropper is necessary for applying along partings but limits dose control and travel convenience. Across the range, the same colour logic distinguishes each product, giving the line strong shelf recognition.

en.name: Aveda Scalp Solutions Replenishing Conditioner
points: Both use clinical scalp-hydration figures — Aveda a time series of +92%/+128%, Briogeo a single "up to 2x"
Briogeo asks the consumer to add a leave-in step while Aveda swaps an existing conditioner; Briogeo faces more resistance but creates a new usage frequency
Briogeo also claims detox, making its message more complex; Aveda stays on hydration alone

en.name: Nécessaire The Scalp Serum
points: Both are leave-in scalp serums, but Briogeo leads on cleansing plus hydration and Nécessaire on hydration plus density
Briogeo has a clinical figure while Nécessaire has stated percentages and NEA acceptance — two different ways of building credibility
Briogeo carries three essential oils and cultivates a cooling sensation; Nécessaire is entirely unscented, the opposite direction for sensitive scalps

en.name: The Ordinary Multi-Peptide Serum for Hair Density
points: They solve different problems: Briogeo scalp comfort and hydration, The Ordinary density
US$32/30 mL against US$24/60 mL — Briogeo costs about 2.7x per mL
Briogeo offers a clinical figure plus sensory feedback while The Ordinary offers only an ingredient list; the persuasion paths are entirely different

insight.zh:
这支产品处理了一个我们在开发时经常遇到的矛盾：清洁与保湿在配方上互斥，但市场同时需要这两个诉求。它的解法是把两者交给不同成分并在时间上错开——金缕梅与三种精油负责即刻的清爽与清凉，Saccharide Isomerate负责测试周期内的长效水分。消费者当场感受到的是「清爽」，数据测出来的是「保湿」，两者不冲突但也不是同一件事。这种分层处理值得直接借用。

更值得注意的是成分分工。宣传前排是活性炭与茶树，产品名、包装配色、系列命名全部围绕它们；但支撑「水分2倍」这个核心数字的，最可能是排在后段、宣传中几乎不提的Saccharide Isomerate。讲故事的成分和出数据的成分是分开的，这在功效型产品里是常态，但如果我们要引用同行数据，就必须先分清哪个成分在承担哪个宣称。

最后一个实操提醒：同一项测试在不同渠道被写成「2X」和「142%」，而142%的提升实际约等于基线的2.42倍。这不是造假，是换算口径不同，但它说明数字一旦离开原始报告就会在渠道传播中发生形变。我们对外给数字时，应该同时规定表述方式，否则代理商和零售商会各自换算。
insight.en:
This product handles a contradiction we hit constantly in development: cleansing and hydration are mutually exclusive in formulation, yet the market wants both. Its solution is to assign them to different ingredients on different timescales — witch hazel and three essential oils for immediate freshness and cooling, saccharide isomerate for long-duration moisture across the test period. What the user feels on the spot is freshness; what the data measures is hydration. They do not conflict, but they are not the same thing. The layering is directly borrowable.

More notable is the division of labour among ingredients. Charcoal and tea tree lead the marketing and own the name, the colourway and the range naming; but the ingredient most likely carrying the central 2x hydration figure is saccharide isomerate, placed late on the list and barely mentioned. Story ingredients and data ingredients are separate — normal in efficacy products, but if we cite a competitor's data we must first work out which ingredient carries which claim.

One practical warning: the same test appears as "2X" on some channels and "142%" on others, and a 142% increase is about 2.42x baseline. This is not falsification but a difference in conversion, and it shows that a number deforms in channel distribution once it leaves the original report. When we release figures, we should mandate the phrasing at the same time, or distributors and retailers will each do their own conversion.

notes.zh: 资料采集日 2026-07-31。成分表以INCIDecoder为准；价格与规格取自Sephora（1 oz US$32.00，订阅US$30.40）。「2X」与「142%」两种表述分别见于品牌官网/Sephora与Boots/Target。

name.zh: Neutrogena Hair Restore Strength + Purity Shampoo
name.en: Neutrogena Hair Restore Strength + Purity Shampoo

company.zh: Kenvue（原Johnson & Johnson消费品部门，2023年分拆独立）
company.en: Kenvue (spun off from Johnson & Johnson's consumer division in 2023)

launch.zh: 2025年11月13日发布，Hair Restore五件套系列的STEP 2；初期Walmart独家，2026年初扩展至其他零售商
launch.en: Announced 13 November 2025 as step 2 of the five-product Hair Restore collection; initially exclusive to Walmart, expanding to other retailers in early 2026

price.zh: US$9.97（Walmart，13 fl oz规格）；洗护套装US$19.94
price.en: US$9.97 at Walmart (13 fl oz size); shampoo + conditioner set US$19.94

market.zh: 美国Walmart独家起步，2026年扩展至全渠道
market.en: Launched exclusively at Walmart in the US, going nationwide across retailers in 2026

sources: Kenvue press release — new scalp health launches

positioning.zh: Kenvue在2025年11月13日同时发布Neutrogena Hair Restore与OGX ProGrowth + Peptide两条产品线，明确以「skinification of hair（护发的护肤化）」为共同战略。这支洗发水是Hair Restore五件套的STEP 2：免硫酸盐基剂配1.5%苦杏仁酸，宣称去除97%残留同时保持发丝强韧。系列由皮肤科医生共同开发，并依托集团旗下Rogaine近35年的头皮研究积累。13.5 fl oz售价US$9.97——这是把原本属于沙龙与高端渠道的头皮科学，用大众药妆价格铺进Walmart货架。
positioning.en: On 13 November 2025 Kenvue launched Neutrogena Hair Restore and OGX ProGrowth + Peptide together, framing both explicitly around the skinification of hair. This shampoo is step 2 of the five-product Hair Restore system: a sulfate-free base with 1.5% mandelic acid, claiming to remove 97% of buildup while keeping hair strong. The line was developed alongside dermatologists and draws on nearly 35 years of scalp research from the group's own Rogaine. At US$9.97 for 13.5 fl oz, it puts scalp science that used to live in salons and prestige channels onto a Walmart shelf at drugstore pricing.

target.zh: 因断裂导致脱发困扰、但不愿进入沙龙或高端渠道的大众消费者；已在Walmart采购日常洗护的家庭用户
target.en: Mass consumers worried about shedding from breakage who will not shop salon or prestige channels, and households already buying their wash routine at Walmart

zh: 因断裂造成脱发感、头发变细的人群
关注头皮健康但不愿支付沙龙价位的大众消费者
习惯在Walmart等大卖场一站式采购的家庭用户
已了解「头皮护理」概念、但缺乏可负担选项的人群
en: People experiencing shedding from breakage and thinning hair
Scalp-aware consumers unwilling to pay salon prices
Households doing one-stop shopping at Walmart and similar mass retailers
People who already understand scalp care but lacked an affordable option

zh: 1.5%苦杏仁酸温和去角质
去除97%头发残留同时保持发丝强韧
免硫酸盐配方
减少因断裂造成的脱发
与皮肤科医生共同开发
Hair Restore五件套的STEP 2（洗发步骤）
en: 1.5% mandelic acid for gentle exfoliation
Removes 97% of buildup while keeping hair strong
Sulfate-free formula
Reduces shedding due to breakage
Developed alongside dermatologists
Step 2 of the five-product Hair Restore system

ingredients.zh: 免硫酸盐基剂配1.5%苦杏仁酸。苦杏仁酸是AHA中分子量最大的一种，渗透慢、刺激低，在护肤品中常用于敏感肌换肤——把它放进洗发水，是护肤活性成分向头皮迁移的直接证据。这与OGX ProGrowth + Peptide洗发水使用同一浓度的苦杏仁酸（1.5%）完全一致：Kenvue在两条线上共用同一个活性成分与同一个浓度，只是宣传语言不同。系列内的差异化交给其他单品——Triple Action Scalp Detox Cleanser带磨砂涂抹头、Advanced Growth Support Serum用专利申请中的Micro-Peptide XP。
ingredients.en: A sulfate-free base with 1.5% mandelic acid. Mandelic is the largest-molecule AHA, penetrating slowly with low irritation, and is standard in skincare for sensitive-skin resurfacing — putting it in a shampoo is direct evidence of skincare actives migrating to the scalp. It is also exactly what the OGX ProGrowth + Peptide shampoo uses, at the identical 1.5%: Kenvue runs the same active at the same level across both lines and differentiates only in language. Differentiation within the system is handled by other items — a scrub applicator on the Triple Action Scalp Detox Cleanser, and patent-pending Micro-Peptide XP in the Advanced Growth Support Serum.

ingredientsNote.zh: 「去除97%残留」与OGX的「去除98%残留」几乎是同一个数字，两支洗发水的活性成分与浓度也完全相同（1.5%苦杏仁酸）。这不是巧合，是同一个研发中心的成本策略：一个配方平台，两个品牌、两个价位、两套话术。Neutrogena讲皮肤科医生与屏障，OGX讲毛发学专家与丰盈感。对我们做多品牌矩阵时，这是可以直接参考的资源复用模型。
ingredientsNote.en: "Removes 97% of buildup" and OGX's "removes 98% of buildup" are practically the same number, and both shampoos run the same active at the same level (1.5% mandelic acid). This is not coincidence but a cost strategy from a single R&D centre: one formulation platform, two brands, two price points, two scripts. Neutrogena talks dermatologists and barrier; OGX talks trichologists and fullness. For anyone running a multi-brand portfolio, this is a directly reusable resource model.

zh.name: 1.5%苦杏仁酸
zh.desc: AHA中分子量最大、刺激最低的一种，原本是敏感肌换肤成分。浓度明确标注，这在大众洗发水中并不常见。

zh.name: 免硫酸盐基剂
zh.desc: 要在洗发水里放酸，基剂必须先降低刺激，否则两者叠加会造成头皮负担。

zh.name: Micro-Peptide XP（系列内精华）
zh.desc: 不在这支洗发水里，但它是整个系列的技术核心，宣称减少最高41%脱发。洗发水的作用是为它清出通路。

zh.name: Rogaine的头皮研究积累
zh.desc: Kenvue同时拥有Rogaine，近35年的头皮研究数据是这条线不需要从零开始的原因。

en.name: 1.5% mandelic acid
en.desc: The largest-molecule, lowest-irritation AHA, originally a sensitive-skin resurfacing ingredient. The percentage is stated, which is unusual for a mass shampoo.

en.name: Sulfate-free base
en.desc: To put an acid in a shampoo the base must first be de-escalated, or the two together burden the scalp.

en.name: Micro-Peptide XP (in the range's serum)
en.desc: Not in this shampoo, but the technical core of the whole system, claiming up to 41% less shedding. The shampoo's job is to clear the path for it.

en.name: Rogaine's scalp research
en.desc: Kenvue also owns Rogaine, and nearly 35 years of scalp research data is why this line did not have to start from zero.

zh.title: Skinification的渠道下沉
zh.desc: 头皮酸类去角质、浓度标注、皮肤科医生背书，这三件事此前只在沙龙线与高端线出现。Kenvue把它们做进US$9.97的Walmart货架产品。概念的普及速度取决于它能否被大众渠道承载，这是分水岭事件。

zh.title: 一个配方平台，两个品牌
zh.desc: Neutrogena与OGX的洗发水使用同一活性、同一浓度（1.5%苦杏仁酸），宣称数字也几乎相同（97% / 98%）。研发成本一次投入，覆盖两个价位与两类人群。

zh.title: 集团内资产的横向调用
zh.desc: Rogaine近35年的头皮研究、Neutrogena的护肤科学、OGX的护发渠道，三块资产被组合成一次发布。这是大集团相对独立品牌的结构性优势——单品牌需要从零建立可信度，集团只需要把已有资产重新排列。

zh.title: 五步系统与外部专家双背书
zh.desc: 洗发、护发素、头皮清洁、精华、口服补充剂五件套，配合皮肤科医生（Neutrogena）与毛发学专家（OGX）两套专业背书。单品之间形成流程依赖，客单价与复购同时提升。

en.title: Skinification reaching mass channels
en.desc: Acid exfoliation for the scalp, stated concentrations and dermatologist endorsement had all previously belonged to salon and prestige lines. Kenvue put them into a US$9.97 product on a Walmart shelf. How fast a concept spreads depends on whether mass channels can carry it, which makes this a watershed.

en.title: One formulation platform, two brands
en.desc: The Neutrogena and OGX shampoos use the same active at the same level (1.5% mandelic acid) and post nearly the same figure (97% / 98%). R&D is funded once and covers two price points and two audiences.

en.title: Calling on assets across the group
en.desc: Nearly 35 years of Rogaine scalp research, Neutrogena's skin science and OGX's haircare distribution were combined into one launch. This is a structural advantage over independent brands: a single brand has to build credibility from nothing, while a group only has to rearrange what it already owns.

en.title: A five-step system with dual expert endorsement
en.desc: Shampoo, conditioner, scalp cleanser, serum and an ingestible supplement, backed by dermatologists at Neutrogena and trichologists at OGX. The items depend on each other as a routine, lifting both basket size and repeat rate.

evidence.zh: 公开的量化宣称是「去除97%残留」，属于清洁力测试而非生发功效数据。系列的核心数字「最高41%减少脱发」属于Advanced Growth Support Serum，不是这支洗发水。Kenvue已宣布针对Hair Restore系列启动自有临床研究，但结果尚未公布。「与皮肤科医生共同开发」是流程描述而非测试结论。Rogaine近35年的头皮研究积累是集团背景，不构成对这支产品的直接证据。引用时必须区分：清洁数据属于洗发水，生发数据属于精华。
evidence.en: The published quantified claim is "removes 97% of buildup", which is a cleansing test rather than growth efficacy. The system's headline figure, up to 41% less shedding, belongs to the Advanced Growth Support Serum, not to this shampoo. Kenvue has announced its own clinical study on the Hair Restore collection, but results are not yet published. "Developed alongside dermatologists" describes a process, not a test outcome. Nearly 35 years of Rogaine scalp research is group background, not direct evidence for this product. When citing, keep the split clear: the cleansing data belongs to the shampoo, the growth data to the serum.

「最高41%减少脱发」属于系列内的精华，非本品
Kenvue已宣布启动Hair Restore自有临床研究，结果未公布
与皮肤科医生共同开发（流程描述，非测试结论）
依托Rogaine近35年头皮研究积累（集团背景）
可引用性：中。清洁数据可引用，生发数据需归属到精华
en: Removes 97% of buildup (a cleansing test; method unpublished)
The "up to 41% less shedding" figure belongs to the range's serum, not this product
Kenvue has announced a proprietary clinical study on Hair Restore; results not yet published
Developed alongside dermatologists (a process description, not a test outcome)
Draws on nearly 35 years of Rogaine scalp research (group background)
Citability: medium. The cleansing figure can be cited; growth data must be attributed to the serum

experience.zh: 免硫酸盐基剂，泡量中等，洗后不涩——这是加了酸之后必须守住的底线，否则大众消费者会直接判定为「太干」。1.5%苦杏仁酸的浓度不会带来可感知的刺激或清凉，使用体验上与普通温和洗发水差别不大。这是刻意的：大众渠道产品不能靠感官冲击说服，它靠的是包装上的数字与皮肤科医生背书。与Briogeo用薄荷清凉感做「功效证明」的路线完全相反。
experience.en: A sulfate-free base with moderate lather and no squeak after rinsing — the floor that must be held once an acid is added, or mass consumers will simply write it off as too drying. At 1.5%, the mandelic acid produces no perceptible tingle or cooling, so the experience is close to an ordinary mild shampoo. That is deliberate: a mass-channel product cannot persuade through sensation, so it persuades through the number on the pack and the dermatologist endorsement. The opposite of Briogeo, which uses peppermint cooling as proof of efficacy.

zh: 泡沫：免硫酸盐基剂，泡量中等，洗后不涩
感受：1.5%浓度不带来可感知刺激，与普通温和洗发水接近
设计意图：不靠感官冲击说服，靠数字与专业背书
规格：13.5 fl oz / 400 mL，大众家庭装
流程：系列STEP 2，前有头皮清洁、后有护发素与精华

Feel: at 1.5% there is no perceptible tingle; close to an ordinary mild shampoo
Intent: it persuades through numbers and endorsement rather than sensation
Size: 13.5 fl oz / 400 mL, a mass household format

packaging.zh: 白底配Neutrogena标志性的深色字体，正面直接印「1.5% MANDELIC ACID」与「SULFATE-FREE」。把浓度印在瓶身正面是护肤线的做法（露得清自己的视黄醇产品就这么做），现在被移植到洗发水上——在Walmart货架上，这个动作把它与周围只写「滋润」「顺滑」的竞品区分开。系列内五件套用同一视觉体系与编号，货架上形成整组陈列。
packaging.en: White with Neutrogena's signature dark type, with "1.5% MANDELIC ACID" and "SULFATE-FREE" printed on the front. Putting a concentration on the front of pack is a skincare habit — Neutrogena's own retinol products do it — now transplanted onto a shampoo, which on a Walmart shelf separates it from neighbours that say only "moisturising" and "smoothing". All five items share one visual system and numbering, so the range blocks together on shelf.

Front of pack: 1.5% MANDELIC ACID / SULFATE-FREE, leading with the concentration

en.channelDesc: A Walmart exclusive builds momentum in one channel before the wider rollout — the standard way mass brands control launch pacing

zh.tagline: Advanced hair growth support designed with dermatologists
zh.concept: Neutrogena以皮肤科医生推荐建立了数十年的护肤信誉，Hair Restore是把这份信誉延伸到头皮的尝试。Kenvue在发布中把「头皮护理不是趋势」作为立论——82%的女性认为健康的头发从健康的头皮开始——并主张用对待面部肌肤的精度来对待头皮。

en.tagline: Advanced hair growth support designed with dermatologists
en.concept: Neutrogena spent decades building credibility on dermatologist recommendation, and Hair Restore extends that credibility to the scalp. Kenvue framed the launch around the position that scalp care is not a trend — 82% of women believe healthy hair growth starts with a healthy scalp — and argued for treating the scalp with the precision reserved for facial skin.

zh.name: OGX ProGrowth + Peptide Clarifying Shampoo（同集团）
points: 同一集团、同日发布、同一活性与浓度（1.5%苦杏仁酸），宣称数字几乎相同（97% vs 98%）
Neutrogena用皮肤科医生背书讲屏障，OGX用毛发学专家背书讲丰盈感——同一配方的两套话术
价格接近（US$9.97 vs US$6.97），OGX更低，覆盖更下沉的价格带

zh.name: CeraVe Gentle Hydrating Shampoo
points: 两者都以皮肤科体系进入头皮，CeraVe讲神经酰胺屏障与保湿，Neutrogena讲酸类去角质与生长支持
CeraVe无香精、路线更保守；Neutrogena把浓度印在正面，更接近功效护肤的表达方式
价格接近（US$10.99/355 mL vs US$9.97/400 mL），是货架上的直接竞争关系

zh.name: 8 THE THALASSO Moist Shampoo（日本）
points: 两者都是skinification的代表，但路径相反：8T用「美容液」这个感性概念，Neutrogena用「1.5%苦杏仁酸」这个成分事实
8T的84%含水，Neutrogena的97%是清洁力测试——同样是数字，可核查程度不同
8T靠香型与包装建立溢价，Neutrogena刻意压低感官表现、把预算放在渠道与背书上

en.name: OGX ProGrowth + Peptide Clarifying Shampoo (same group)
points: Same group, same launch day, same active at the same level (1.5% mandelic acid), with near-identical figures (97% vs 98%)
Neutrogena uses dermatologists to talk barrier, OGX uses trichologists to talk fullness — two scripts over one formula
Prices are close (US$9.97 vs US$6.97), with OGX reaching a lower tier

en.name: CeraVe Gentle Hydrating Shampoo
points: Both enter the scalp through a dermatological system, CeraVe on ceramide barrier and hydration, Neutrogena on acid exfoliation and growth support
CeraVe is fragrance-free and more conservative; Neutrogena puts the percentage on the front, closer to active-skincare phrasing
Prices are close (US$10.99/355 mL vs US$9.97/400 mL), making them direct shelf competitors

en.name: 8 THE THALASSO Moist Shampoo (Japan)
points: Both represent skinification but from opposite directions: 8T through the emotive idea of a beauty serum, Neutrogena through the factual "1.5% mandelic acid"
8T's 84% includes water while Neutrogena's 97% is a cleansing test — both numbers, but verifiable to different degrees
8T builds premium through scent and packaging; Neutrogena deliberately suppresses sensory expression and spends on channel and endorsement instead

insight.zh:
这次发布的意义不在配方，在渠道。头皮酸类去角质、正面标注浓度、皮肤科医生背书——这三件事在此之前只出现在沙龙线与高端线，本库里对应的是Aveda、Briogeo、Nécessaire这些US$30-50的产品。Kenvue把同一套做法压到US$9.97放进Walmart。一个概念从高端下沉到大众渠道，通常意味着它已经过了教育期、进入了规模化竞争阶段。对我们的判断影响是直接的：如果还打算把「头皮护理」当作差异化卖点，窗口正在关闭。

第二点是集团的资源复用。Neutrogena与OGX的洗发水用同一活性、同一浓度、几乎同一个宣称数字，只是背书专家不同（皮肤科医生 vs 毛发学专家）、价位不同（US$9.97 vs US$6.97）。一个配方平台覆盖两个品牌两个价格带，研发成本一次投入。再加上Rogaine近35年的头皮研究积累——Kenvue不需要从零建立头皮领域的可信度，只需要把集团内已有的资产重新排列。这是独立品牌无法对抗的结构性优势，也是我们做多品牌矩阵时应该照搬的模型。

引用时要注意拆分：「97%去除残留」是这支洗发水的清洁力数据，「最高41%减少脱发」属于系列内的精华。Kenvue在传播中把两个数字放在同一个系列叙事里，消费者容易混淆，但我们做竞品分析时必须分开归属。
insight.en:
The significance of this launch is not the formula but the channel. Acid exfoliation for the scalp, front-of-pack concentrations and dermatologist endorsement had appeared only in salon and prestige lines — in this library, that means Aveda, Briogeo and Nécessaire at US$30-50. Kenvue compressed the same playbook into US$9.97 on a Walmart shelf. When a concept descends from prestige to mass, it usually means the education phase is over and scale competition has begun. The implication for us is direct: if we still plan to use scalp care as a differentiator, the window is closing.

Second is resource reuse inside a group. The Neutrogena and OGX shampoos share one active, one concentration and almost one claim figure, differing only in which experts endorse them (dermatologists vs trichologists) and at what price (US$9.97 vs US$6.97). One formulation platform covers two brands and two price tiers on a single R&D spend. Add nearly 35 years of Rogaine scalp research and Kenvue never had to build scalp credibility from zero — it only had to rearrange assets it already owned. That is a structural advantage no independent brand can match, and the model to copy when we build a multi-brand portfolio.

One caution when citing: "97% of buildup removed" is this shampoo's cleansing data, while "up to 41% less shedding" belongs to the range's serum. Kenvue places both inside one range narrative and consumers conflate them, but competitive analysis has to keep the attribution separate.

notes.zh: 资料采集日 2026-07-31。发布日期与系列构成取自Kenvue官方新闻稿与Chain Drug Review（2025年11月13日）。价格取自Walmart（13 fl oz规格US$9.97，洗护套装US$19.94）；Neutrogena官网标注13.5 fl oz。「依托Rogaine近35年头皮研究积累」为Kenvue集团资产背景，Rogaine同属Kenvue。
notes.en: Researched 2026-07-31. Launch date and range composition from Kenvue's press release and Chain Drug Review (13 November 2025). Price from Walmart (13 fl oz at US$9.97; shampoo and conditioner set US$19.94); Neutrogena's own site lists 13.5 fl oz. The reference to nearly 35 years of Rogaine scalp research reflects group assets — Rogaine is also owned by Kenvue.

positioning.zh: Kenvue在2025年11月13日同时发布的两条线中，走更下沉价位的一条。ProGrowth + Peptide系统的第一步，由毛发学专家（trichologist）共同开发，宣称1.5%苦杏仁酸去除最高98%残留、疏通毛囊。385 mL售价US$6.97，单毫升约US$0.018——是本库中最便宜的产品。同系列精华用9% Long7vity Complex，全套使用宣称最高3倍丰盈感。
positioning.en: The lower-priced of the two lines Kenvue launched on 13 November 2025. Step 1 of the ProGrowth + Peptide system, co-developed with trichologists, claiming that 1.5% mandelic acid removes up to 98% of buildup and unclogs follicles. At US$6.97 for 385 mL, about US$0.018/mL, it is the cheapest product in this library. The range's serum runs a 9% Long7vity Complex, and the full routine claims up to 3x fuller-looking hair.

预算敏感、在大卖场货架上即时决策的购买者

ingredients.zh: 水、C14-16烯烃磺酸钠、椰油酰胺丙基甜菜碱、癸基葡糖苷、苦杏仁酸、豌豆肽（Pisum Sativum Peptide）、水解米蛋白、烟酰胺、羟丙基三甲基氯化铵淀粉、亚油酰胺丙基PG-二甲基氯化铵磷酸盐、椰油葡糖苷、泛醇、油酸甘油酯、马铃薯淀粉衍生物、苯甲酸钠、香精、柠檬酸。苦杏仁酸位列第5，与宣传的1.5%浓度位置相符。肽为豌豆来源，烟酰胺是护肤品的标准活性。需要注意基剂：C14-16烯烃磺酸钠是硫酸盐替代品但清洁力偏强，与Neutrogena的免硫酸盐路线不同——同一集团在两个价位上做了不同取舍。
ingredients.en: Water, sodium C14-16 olefin sulfonate, cocamidopropyl betaine, decyl glucoside, mandelic acid, pea peptide, hydrolysed rice protein, niacinamide, starch hydroxypropyltrimonium chloride, linoleamidopropyl PG-dimonium chloride phosphate, coco-glucoside, panthenol, glyceryl oleate, a potato starch derivative, sodium benzoate, fragrance and citric acid. Mandelic acid sits fifth, consistent with the stated 1.5%. The peptide is pea-derived and niacinamide is a standard skincare active. Note the base: sodium C14-16 olefin sulfonate is a sulfate substitute but cleanses fairly strongly, unlike Neutrogena's sulfate-free route — the same group made different trade-offs at two price points.

ingredientsNote.zh: 这支产品与Neutrogena Hair Restore Strength + Purity Shampoo使用同一活性成分与同一浓度（1.5%苦杏仁酸），宣称数字也几乎相同（98% vs 97%）。差异在基剂：Neutrogena用免硫酸盐、OGX用烯烃磺酸钠，后者成本更低、清洁力更强。同一个研发平台在两个价位上做出的取舍非常清楚——高价位买的是更温和的基剂，活性成分本身没有区别。这对我们做价格分层时是直接可用的参考：分层不必靠更换活性，调整基剂就能形成体感差异与成本差异。
ingredientsNote.en: This shampoo uses the same active at the same level as Neutrogena Hair Restore Strength + Purity (1.5% mandelic acid), with nearly the same figure (98% vs 97%). The difference is the base: Neutrogena is sulfate-free while OGX uses olefin sulfonate, which is cheaper and cleanses harder. The trade-off one R&D platform made across two price points is unusually visible — the higher price buys a milder base, not a different active. That is directly usable for our own tiering: you do not need to swap actives to create tiers, since adjusting the base produces both the sensory gap and the cost gap.

zh.name: 1.5%苦杏仁酸
zh.desc: 位列成分表第5位。AHA中分子量最大、刺激最低的一种，从护肤换肤成分迁移到大众洗发水。

zh.name: 豌豆肽
zh.desc: 产品名中的Peptide对应这个成分。植物来源肽，成本低于合成多肽，是大众价位能标注「肽」的关键。

zh.name: 烟酰胺
zh.desc: 护肤品的标准活性，在US$6.97的洗发水里出现，本身就是skinification下沉的证据。

zh.name: C14-16烯烃磺酸钠
zh.desc: 硫酸盐替代品，成本低但清洁力偏强。这是与Neutrogena免硫酸盐版本的核心差异所在。

en.name: 1.5% mandelic acid
en.tag: Same active and level as Neutrogena
en.desc: Fifth on the list. The largest-molecule, lowest-irritation AHA, migrating from skincare resurfacing into a mass shampoo.

en.name: Pea peptide
en.desc: The Peptide in the name maps to this ingredient. A plant-derived peptide, cheaper than synthetic ones, and what makes a peptide claim possible at this price.

en.name: Niacinamide
en.desc: A standard skincare active appearing in a US$6.97 shampoo — evidence of skinification reaching mass in itself.

en.name: Sodium C14-16 olefin sulfonate
en.desc: A sulfate substitute that is cheap but cleanses hard. This is the core difference from the sulfate-free Neutrogena version.

zh.title: 同一配方平台的价格分层
zh.desc: 与Neutrogena共用1.5%苦杏仁酸，只更换基剂与包装，做出US$6.97与US$9.97两个价位。分层靠的是基剂成本与感官差异，不是活性成分——这是成本效率最高的分层方式。

zh.title: 背书专家的差异化配置
zh.desc: Neutrogena配皮肤科医生，OGX配毛发学专家（trichologist）。同一集团用两类专业身份覆盖两类消费者心理：一类信任医学权威，一类信任头发领域的专门性。背书成本远低于研发成本。

zh.title: 即时结果的宣称策略
zh.desc: 官方措辞明确强调「一次使用即见效」与「instant-gratification」。在大众渠道，消费者不会为需要8周才见效的产品复购，所以宣称必须压缩到单次使用可感知的范围内。

zh.title: 系统叠加的数字放大
zh.desc: 单品宣称98%去除残留，全套（洗发水＋护发素＋精华喷雾）宣称最高3倍丰盈感。把最大数字绑定在全套使用上，是提升客单价的标准手法。

en.title: Price tiering off one formulation platform
en.desc: It shares 1.5% mandelic acid with Neutrogena and changes only the base and packaging to produce US$6.97 and US$9.97 tiers. The tiering rests on base cost and sensory difference rather than actives — the most cost-efficient way to tier.

en.title: Differentiating by which experts endorse
en.desc: Dermatologists for Neutrogena, trichologists for OGX. One group covers two consumer mindsets with two professional identities: one trusts medical authority, the other trusts hair-specific specialism. Endorsement costs a fraction of R&D.

en.title: Claiming immediate results
en.desc: The official wording stresses results in one use and an instant-gratification approach. In mass channels consumers will not repurchase something that takes eight weeks, so claims have to compress into what a single wash can deliver.

en.title: Scaling the number through the system
en.desc: The single product claims 98% buildup removal while the full routine — shampoo, conditioner and serum mist — claims up to 3x fuller-looking hair. Attaching the biggest number to the full routine is the standard way to lift basket size.

evidence.zh: 「去除最高98%残留」为清洁力测试，方法未公开。「最高3倍丰盈感」标注为仪器测试、全套使用对比未处理头发——注意对照组是「未处理头发」而非「使用普通洗发水」，这个对照设置会显著放大差值。「减少因断裂造成的脱发」同样标注为全套使用的仪器结果。系列精华的9% Long7vity Complex是唯一公开浓度的复合物。「由毛发学专家共同开发」是流程描述。所有数字都带「up to（最高）」限定，属于最优值而非平均值。
evidence.en: "Removes up to 98% of buildup" is a cleansing test with no published method. "Up to 3x fuller-looking hair" is footnoted as instrumental results with the full routine versus untreated hair — note that the control is untreated hair rather than an ordinary shampoo, which materially inflates the gap. "Reduces hair fall due to breakage" is likewise an instrumental result for the full routine. The 9% Long7vity Complex in the range's serum is the only complex with a published concentration. "Developed with trichologists" describes process. Every figure carries an "up to" qualifier, making them best cases rather than averages.
